About Our Client & The Engagemen t

Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense


About the Engagement

A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.


What You Will Own

  • Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.
  • Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing.
  • Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams.
  • Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates.
  • Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances.
  • Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.
  • Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.
  • Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.

Responsibilities

  • Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off.
  • Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review.
  • Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked.
  • Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery.
  • Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.
  • Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency.
  • Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.
  • Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products.
  • Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging).
  • Strong technical fluency: data modeling, event-driven systems, API contracts, authorization models, and cloud infra (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Proven ownership of scope and change management on ambiguous, evolving engagements.
  • Cross-team dependency and interface management across interlocking services.
  • Strong stakeholder management; able to run and close schema, policy, and SLA sign-offs.
  • Large-scale data migration and phased rollout: dual-run, shadow mode, cutover, rollback.
  • Credible with engineers on distributed-systems trade-offs: idempotency, delivery semantics, replay, backpressure, latency.

Bonus

  • EdTech, SIS, or student-rostering experience.
  • Depth in data integration, access control (ABAC/RBAC), API gateways, segmentation, or messaging platforms.
  • Hands-on with a GCP-native stack (Dataflow/Beam, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Terraform).
  • Senior consulting or client-services delivery experience.
  • An engineering or technical background earlier in your career.
  • Built reusable migration or onboarding tooling that runs per client.

Benefits

hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across Colombia, Argentina or Bulgaria. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

  • Competitive Pay – compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments.
  • Remote Flexibility – work from anywhere within your local country (Colombia or Argentina), with the option to use co-working space as available locally.
  • Paid Time Off – ample vacation days to rest and recharge.
  • Public Holidays – all local federal holidays are fully paid days off.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data.


Position Overview

As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report.


What You’ll Do

  • Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization.
  • Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity.
  • Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data.
  • Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.).
  • Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses.
  • Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights.
  • Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor.
  • Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels.


Who You Are

  • 2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills.
  • Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data.
  • Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor.
  • Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership
  • Excellent written and spoken English; can explain technical findings to non-technical teams.
  • Strong documentation habits.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative.
  • Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção do grupo Omnicom, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O seu papel:

Como Analista Pleno de Operações Regulatórias, você trabalhará no envio de materiais promocionais e não promocionais para o portal de revisão e aprovação dos clientes, garantindo que os materiais estejam em conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e as especificidades da marca, seguindo os padrões da indústria, bem como os processos do cliente. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras equipes na agência, garantindo uma comunicação eficiente até o envio de materiais para os portais do cliente (Veeva PromoMats, FUSE). Você deve ser um pensador crítico e naturalmente interessado em aprender novos sistemas e processos para a agência e seu portfólio de marcas. Você também deve ter excelente organização, comunicação e atenção aos detalhes para garantir a precisão e eficiência dos envios, bem como a capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente orientado a prazos.


Suas responsabilidades:

• Trabalhar em parceria com a equipe de Operações Regulatórias dos EUA no processo de submissão de materiais para aprovação de MLR;

• Garantir que as submissões atendam a todos os requisitos necessários de acordo com os requisitos regulatórios, necessidades e SOPs de cada cliente;

• Colaborar com equipes internas da marca (atendimento ao cliente, escritores, PMs) na preparação da submissão de materiais desenvolvidos pela agência para as submissões médicas/legais/regulatórias (MLR) do cliente, garantindo que as submissões sejam concluídas corretamente;

• Participar de reuniões de início de projetos e alinhamento com as equipes da marca dos EUA, conforme necessário;

• Auxiliar na revisão e implementação de novos processos de submissão de materiais;

• Manter uma boa comunicação, ser proativo em sua abordagem e cultivar relacionamentos com equipes parceiras.


Requisitos necessários:

• Bacharelado em Ciências Farmacêuticas ou área da saúde.

• 2 anos ou mais de experiência em indústria farmacêutica (áreas: marketing, médica ou relacionada).

• Compreensão do processo de revisão e aprovação de material promocional.

• Capacidade de conciliar vários projetos enquanto cumpre os prazos do cliente.

• Habilidades de planejamento, resolução de problemas, priorização e gerenciamento de tempo/organização.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.

• Fluência em inglês: leitura, interpretação de texto, escrita e fala, pois trabalhará diretamente com o time dos EUA no dia a dia.

• Altamente desejável: conhecimento do fluxo de revisão/aprovação de materiais no Veeva PromoMats, incluindo ancoragem e anotação de referências.

title: Analista de Faturamento Pleno/Sênior (Vaga Temporária)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Faturamento Pleno/Sênior (Vaga Temporária) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Outsorce: Apoiamos as organizações em todas as etapas de sua jornada de terceirização de RH e folha de pagamento, ajudando-as a operar em conformidade com as normas, de forma eficiente e em grande escala. Nossa mais recente captação de recursos, no valor de 500 milhões de euros, tem como objetivo acelerar nosso crescimento e nossa expansão internacional. Nossa meta é dobrar nossa receita em cinco anos e nos tornarmos líderes mundiais em transformação digital de RH. A HR Path é uma empresa global de consultoria em RH. Oferecemos assessoria profissional e apoio a organizações para as quais o capital humano é essencial em seu processo de transformação de RH. Com presença nas Américas, na Europa e na Ásia-Pacífico, podemos oferecer suporte global no desenvolvimento e na execução da estratégia de RH de nossos clientes.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Receber e interpretar informações de faturamento provenientes das áreas internas (comercial, projetos, operações), garantindo precisão e completude dos dados
  • Criar e gerenciar Ordens de Venda no SAP , assegurando o correto preenchimento de todos os campos obrigatórios (cliente, material, condições de pagamento, centros de custo, etc.)
  • Executar o processo de faturamento no SAP (emissão de NF-e / NFS-e), garantindo conformidade fiscal e tributária
  • Realizar o cancelamento, estorno ou correção de documentos fiscais quando necessário, dentro dos prazos legais


Portais de Clientes e Submissão de Notas Fiscais


  • Realizar o upload e submissão de notas fiscais nos portais eletrônicos dos clientes (plataformas como Ariba, Coupa, portais proprietários, entre outros)
  • Monitorar o status de aprovação e pagamento das notas submetidas nos portais
  • Identificar e tratar recusas, inconsistências ou bloqueios nos portais, atuando em conjunto com as áreas de suporte e cliente quando necessário
  • Manter atualizado o cadastro de clientes e requisitos específicos de cada portal


Certificação e Validação das Informações


  • Verificar a acurácia das informações fiscais (CNPJ, endereço, tributação, alíquotas, NCM, CFOP) antes da emissão de cada documento fiscal
  • Validar a aderência contratual entre o que está sendo faturado e o que foi acordado com o cliente (escopo, valor, periodicidade)
  • Conferir dados bancários e condições de pagamento registrados no SAP antes da emissão da nota
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos de faturamento definidos no calendário mensal e nas obrigações contratuais


Conciliação e Controle


  • Realizar a conciliação entre o SAP e o sistema interno (DASH) , identificando e tratando divergências de valores, competências e lançamentos
  • Efetuar a conciliação com a Prefeitura (portal ISS / NFS-e municipal), garantindo que todas as notas emitidas estejam devidamente registradas e sem pendências junto ao município
  • Controlar o ciclo completo do faturamento : da emissão da ordem até a liquidação do título em aberto
  • Elaborar e manter planilhas e relatórios de controle de faturamento mensal, comparando o realizado com o planejado


Cobrança e Relacionamento com Clientes


  • Acompanhar o aging de recebíveis , identificando notas em atraso ou próximas do vencimento
  • Realizar cobranças preventivas e reativas junto aos clientes, por e-mail e telefone, de forma profissional e orientada à solução
  • Tratar contestações e disputas de notas fiscais, reunindo documentação de suporte e articulando resolução com as áreas internas
  • Registrar e escalar adequadamente os casos de inadimplência recorrente


Análise e Melhoria de Processos

  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria no processo de faturamento, propondo soluções e automações
  • Apoiar na documentação de processos (POPs — Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) da área de faturamento
  • Produzir análises e indicadores de desempenho da área (tempo médio de faturamento, taxa de rejeição de notas, volume faturado por período, entre outros)
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e integrações sistêmicas envolvendo SAP e ferramentas de gestão
  • Irá participar proativamente da reforma tributária, testes e melhorias



O que oferecemos:


  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)


Nos vemos em breve na HR Path!

title: Finance Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Associate em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Prismapar is an advisory and venture firm specializing in M&A, corporate finance, business development, and venture funding for companies in expansion or strategic repositioning. The firm supports clients across business growth, mergers and acquisitions, strategic sales, and capital raising from banks, private equity funds, and capital markets. Acting as a “Business Development Partner,” Prismapar works from initial strategy formulation through implementation, helping managers stay focused on core operations during complex transactions. Prismapar also manages funds focused on venture capital and search opportunities, and advises international groups and private equity funds on opportunities in key Latin American markets.

Role Description Prismapar is looking for a Brazilian (or PT-BR native) ideally based in LATAM, although most of the work is remote. In this role, the Finance Associate supports advisory and venture projects by preparing and analyzing financial statements, assisting with financial reporting packages, and contributing to valuation and capital-raising analyses. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and updating financial models, conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis for client engagements, and organizing data and documentation for transactions such as mergers, acquisitions, and strategic sales. The Finance Associate will collaborate with senior team members, prepare clear summaries and presentations for internal and client use, and help ensure accurate, timely financial information for decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Finance, including understanding of corporate finance concepts and transaction processes.
  • Proficiency in Financial Statements and Financial Reporting, with the ability to interpret and prepare key reports.
  • Advanced Analytical Skills, including experience with financial modeling, data analysis, and scenario evaluation.
  • Effective Communication skills, both written and verbal, to present complex financial information clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced usage of AI and AI Agentic tools
  • Comfort working in Excel and other analytical tools; familiarity with presentation software (e.g., PowerPoint) is beneficial.
  • Detail-oriented approach, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in corporate transactions, venture funding, and Latin American markets; previous exposure to advisory or investment environments is a plus.

title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data.


Position Overview

As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report.


What You’ll Do

  • Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization.
  • Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity.
  • Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data.
  • Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.).
  • Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses.
  • Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights.
  • Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor.
  • Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels.


Who You Are

  • 2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills.
  • Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data.
  • Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor.
  • Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership
  • Excellent written and spoken English; can explain technical findings to non-technical teams.
  • Strong documentation habits.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative.
  • Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.


We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources
  • Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks
  • Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences
  • Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership

title: Cloud Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: Azure Cloud Architect

Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone)

Contract: 6 month+ extensions


This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone.


You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy.


Day to day, you will:

  • Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t.
  • Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start.
  • Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements.
  • Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies.
  • Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security.
  • Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale.
  • Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time.
  • Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them.
  • Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly.
  • Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
  • Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change.
  • Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards.
  • Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS.
  • Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions.
  • Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams.
  • Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles.


Required

  • Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent.
  • 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations.
  • 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services.
  • Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM.
  • Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design.
  • Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal.
  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment.
  • Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS.


How you work

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions.
  • Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

Modalidade: Remota

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de IA Generativa para liderar a definição da estratégia, arquitetura e evolução de uma plataforma de IA que será incorporada ao aplicativo de cartão da companhia. Procuramos um profissional com perfil visionário, capaz de atuar tanto em decisões arquiteturais quanto na implementação prática das soluções, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, governança e alinhamento aos objetivos de negócio.


Você será responsável por desenhar e evoluir arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs, RAG avançado e sistemas multiagentes, definindo padrões técnicos, integrações e boas práticas para um ambiente crítico e altamente regulado, com requisitos de auditabilidade, conformidade (BACEN/LGPD) e alta disponibilidade.



Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções de IA utilizando LLMs, RAG e sistemas multiagentes.
  • Conhecimento avançado em padrões modernos de RAG, incluindo Multi-Query, Hybrid Search, Re-Ranking e GraphRAG.
  • Experiência prática com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e integrações Agent-to-Agent (A2A).
  • Vivência na construção e operação de arquiteturas multiagentes distribuídas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA, como Claude Code, Antigravity ou equivalentes.
  • Domínio de Spec-Driven Development (SDD).
  • Experiência com bancos vetoriais e estratégias de embeddings, chunking e retrieval.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python aplicado a soluções de IA.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento backend, integração de APIs e microsserviços.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas distribuídos, mensageria, observabilidade, resiliência e escalabilidade.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluindo Vertex AI, BigQuery e Spanner.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, visão estratégica e atuação hands-on.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente financeiro, bancário ou meios de pagamento.
  • Conhecimento em governança de IA, segurança da informação e conformidade com LGPD.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e avaliação contínua de aplicações de IA em produção.
  • Vivência na definição de métricas de qualidade, custo, latência e eficiência de agentes inteligentes.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Sr. Functional Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Functional Consultant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior Functional Consultant


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Demonstrate thorough knowledge of industry best practices, business processes, o9’s solutions, technical architecture, and value proposition
  • Responsible for solution usability and uptime by resolving any customer issues in a timely fashion, ensuring the accuracy of data loads and validating the e2e workflows
  • Identify any design issues in the existing setup and coordinate with other o9 consultants to solve the business problem. Be the single point of contact for any platform level upgrade/patch/hotfix
  • Configure the o9 platform based on the change requests/enhancements post go-live and deliver them to solve deep operations / supply chain problems
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test cases. Work on bugs/issues and track progress at resolving issues using support tool
  • Support Super User and End User training, for a global user base
  • Actively help in improving internal processes and product features based on customer feedback by interfacing with the development and operations teams.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: 2+ years of experience with implementing supply chain demand planning applications.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems or a related field Languages: SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar; Statistical, Optimization and Simulation skills through software tools and packages like R, SAS, CPLEX or similar is desirable.


Skills:

  • Deep understanding of supply chain planning concepts including Demand Management, Distribution Planning, Master Planning and S&OP.


Characteristics:

  • Strong ability to lead by example and demonstrate proficiency in both product and domain. Patient listener with the ability to clearly articulate your viewpoint to manage and deliver to customer expectations, even under pressure.
  • Ability to analyze and process large amounts of data and complement it with intuition to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is key.
  • We really value team spirit: Transparency and frequent communication is key. At o9, this is not limited by hierarchy, distance, or function.


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.



More About Us

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Writer (Brasil) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.


Key Responsibilities


1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing

  • Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.
  • Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.
  • Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.
  • Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.
  • Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization

  • Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.
  • Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.
  • Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement

  • Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.
  • Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.
  • Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.
  • Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery

  • Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.
  • Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.
  • Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.
  • Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses

  • Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.
  • Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.
  • Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration

  • Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.
  • Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.
  • Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization

  • Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.
  • Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.
  • Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.
  • Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.
  • Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.
  • Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.
  • Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.
  • Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de viagens sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

✨ Venha crescer com o Grupo Kontik ✨


O Grupo Kontik é um hub de negócios com mais de 70 anos de história no mercado de viagens, atuando em diferentes segmentos, como corporativo, lazer, luxo e eventos. Conectamos tradição e inovação com uma cultura de performance clara e praticada no dia a dia.

Nossa atuação é guiada por cinco pilares culturais, que orientam decisões, comportamentos e entregas:

• Performance e execução disciplinada, com foco em qualidade, prazos e resultados consistentes;

• Decisão inteligente e baseada em dados, priorizando análises, indicadores e escolhas bem fundamentadas;

• Colaboração e sinergia entre times, com comunicação clara e trabalho conjunto;

• Inovação, adaptabilidade e olhar para o futuro, evoluindo continuamente e ajustando rotas quando necessário;

• Viajante no centro, garantindo que nossas decisões gerem valor real para quem utiliza nossos serviços.


A oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Viagens Corporativas Pleno para atuar em uma operação dinâmica e estratégica de atendimento ao cliente corporativo.

Essa posição é ideal para profissionais com sólida experiência em viagens corporativas, autonomia na gestão das demandas do dia a dia e domínio das principais ferramentas utilizadas na operação, garantindo uma experiência consultiva e eficiente aos viajantes.

Você será responsável por conduzir processos de viagens nacionais e internacionais, oferecendo suporte especializado, respeitando SLAs, políticas de viagem e garantindo a melhor solução para cada solicitação.


Principais responsabilidades


Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes corporativos por telefone, e-mail e plataformas de Self Booking;

Efetuar reservas, emissões, alterações e reemissões de serviços aéreos nacionais e internacionais;

Apoiar clientes em processos de reembolso conforme regras tarifárias das companhias aéreas;

Orientar viajantes quanto à documentação necessária para viagens nacionais e internacionais;

Aplicar políticas de fornecedores e viagens corporativas durante os atendimentos;

Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e mudanças do mercado de turismo corporativo;

Garantir qualidade operacional e excelência na experiência do cliente.



Como essa posição se conecta com nossa cultura

Aqui na Kontik, você terá a oportunidade de:

Entregar soluções com qualidade e foco em resultados;

Utilizar informações e indicadores para uma tomada de decisão mais assertiva;

Atuar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas e parceiros;

Vivência em atendimento por telefone, e-mail e OBTs/Self Booking;

Experiência com processos aéreos e terrestres nacionais e internacionais;

Conhecimento em acompanhamento e gestão de SLA;

Vivência com reservas, emissões, alterações e reemissões.

Excel Intermediário;

SABRE Intermediário;

Portais de companhias aéreas (e-Gol e e-Latam);

Reemissões voluntárias e involuntárias simples;

OBTs: Argo, Lemontech, Concur e Gover;

Backoffice Benner;

Portais de hotelaria, locadoras, rodoviários e trens;

Processos operacionais de viagens corporativas;

Reembolso conforme regras tarifárias;

Documentação de viagens (vistos e passaportes);

Cartões corporativos e formas de pagamento de despesas de viagem;

Conhecimento do mercado de turismo corporativo.


Formação: Ensino médio completo; ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Turismo, Administração, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
