About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Qualificações:

title: Global Head of Customer Support
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Head of Customer Support em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives.
  • Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management
  • Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance
  • Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers.
  • Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently.
  • Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including FreshService and equivalent service management platforms
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization
  • Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities.
  • Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within SaaS or software businesses.
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong technical acumen across SaaS architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases
  • Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence.
  • Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation.
  • Familiarity with FreshService or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale.
  • Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).


This is a CLT role R$40-50K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) Fiscal em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

CONSULTOR(A) FISCAL 

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia para propor, criar e testar novas soluções
  • Cultura colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


  • Apurar tributos do Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido para empresas prestadoras de serviços
  • Preparar, validar e transmitir obrigações acessórias: PGDAS-D, EFD-Reinf, eSocial, DCTFWeb, DEFIS e demais declarações
  • Conferir e escriturar documentos fiscais e livros, assegurando a correta apuração dos impostos
  • Efetuar conciliações fiscais e apoiar o fechamento mensal das empresas
  • Realizar procedimentos de encerramento municipal e acompanhar as exigências de cada prefeitura
  • Levantar pendências fiscais das empresas e conduzir a regularização 
  • Acompanhar parcelamentos de impostos
  • Contatar o cliente para dar visibilidade da situação fiscal e viabilizar a regularização
  • Calcular folha, pró-labore, INSS e Fator R, com simulações e recálculos
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, padronização e automação das rotinas fiscais, propondo soluções que aumentem a eficiência e reduzam riscos
  • Reportar ao time de tecnologia as inconsistências encontradas na plataforma da Adaflow
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre mudanças na legislação tributária e avaliar seus impactos nos processos internos e nos clientes


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo
  • Vivência em rotina fiscal completa, com experiência em escritório de contabilidade
  • Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de serviços, no Simples Nacional e no Lucro Presumido
  • Vivência em folha e rotinas de departamento pessoal (pró-labore, INSS, Fator R)
  • Conhecimento em planejamento tributário e revisão fiscal
  • Organização e disciplina com prazos, lidando com várias empresas ao mesmo tempo
  • Experiência com Domínio, Onvio e sistemas similares
  • Excel avançado
  • Interesse em acompanhar a Reforma Tributária e seus impactos na rotina dos clientes
  • Comunicação clara, direta e empática, no texto e em reuniões
  • Autonomia para organizar o próprio trabalho no remoto
  • Conforto com metas, porque volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e satisfação do cliente fazem parte do seu dia


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda  
  • Interesse real por tecnologia e produto. Você quer entender como funciona o que está atendendo

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.


About SigmaMD


SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.


About this role


We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.


Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.


This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.


And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.


You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.


What you'll do


Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.


Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.


Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.


Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.


Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.


What we're looking for


1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.


2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.


3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.


4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.


Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.


Who you might be


You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.


Nice to have


  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.


Our values


Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

title: Arquitetura Azure
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura Azure em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Azure).

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM
  • Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture
  • Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra
  • Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling
  • Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud
  • Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono
  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding
  • Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas
  • Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.


Desejável:


  • Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção
  • Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS
  • ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas células
  • Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço
  • Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula
  • Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Technical Sales Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Sales Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Technical Sales Specialist – Construction Products


Location: Remote – Anywhere in LATAM

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Employment Type: Employee

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience


About the Role

We are seeking a technically knowledgeable professional to support customers with construction-related products, technical quotations, specifications, and project requirements.

This position combines technical analysis, estimating, customer communication, and sales support. The successful candidate will review project information, prepare accurate quotations, answer product-related questions, and help customers identify appropriate solutions.

This is a technical sales position rather than a general customer-service role. Training will be provided on the company’s products, quoting procedures, and sales processes.


Responsibilities
  • Review architectural drawings, measurements, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Prepare accurate technical quotations and pricing proposals.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or contradictory project information.
  • Communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements.
  • Explain product options, specifications, pricing, and project considerations clearly.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, and other internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of quotations, customer communications, and project updates.
  • Follow up on open quotations and support opportunities through the sales process.
  • Develop detailed knowledge of the company’s construction products and systems.
  • Provide professional support to customers primarily located in the United States.


Required Qualifications
  • Completed, or nearing completion of, a degree in a relevant technical field, such as:
  • Architecture
  • Civil engineering
  • Architectural engineering
  • Construction engineering
  • Industrial design
  • Product design involving physical products or building systems
  • A closely related engineering or construction discipline
  • Advanced professional English proficiency, approximately CEFR C1 or higher.
  • Ability to communicate naturally and confidently with customers in English.
  • Ability to explain technical information in a clear and organized manner.
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand drawings, dimensions, specifications, and product information.
  • Availability to work full-time during the established U.S. Eastern Time schedule.
  • Reliable computer, internet connection, webcam, and workspace suitable for professional calls and confidential business conversations.


Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

  • Construction or architectural-product estimating
  • Doors, windows, glass, glazing, cabinetry, millwork, or building materials
  • Reading construction drawings, plans, measurements, and specifications
  • Preparing technical quotations, estimates, or pricing proposals
  • Coordinating with customers, suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, or installation teams
  • Technical sales, project coordination, or customer-facing construction roles

Previous experience with doors is helpful but not required.


Virtual-Office Environment

This position operates in a live, video-enabled virtual office during scheduled working hours. Team members are expected to keep their video enabled and remain available for real-time communication and collaboration, except during approved breaks, private conversations, or when an accommodation or applicable law requires otherwise.

Applicants should carefully consider this working arrangement before applying.


Interview Process

Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in an English-language video interview covering:

  • Technical education and relevant experience
  • Experience with drawings, specifications, estimating, or quotations
  • Problem-solving and project coordination
  • Interest in developing a technical sales career
  • Schedule, equipment, and virtual-office availability
  • Compensation expectations and potential start date

Applicants will be informed before any interview is recorded, and recordings will only be collected with their consent.


Equal Opportunity
  • We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process and, where applicable, in the performance of the role.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Lead em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About PerkUp

PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.com.


We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.


This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.


The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.


This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations.
  • Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy.
  • Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability.
  • Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix.
  • Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls.
  • Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.


What success looks like

  • Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably.
  • Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors.
  • Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence.
  • PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.


What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment.
  • A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator.
  • Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.
  • Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.
  • Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.
  • A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.
  • Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.
  • Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.


Role details

  • Location: Remote, Latin America
  • Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time
  • Engagement: Full-time contractor
  • $4,500–$5,000 USD per month


Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

title: R&D Documentation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para R&D Documentation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role

Kor Nutra is seeking a detail-oriented R&D Documentation Specialist to support our nutraceutical gummy research and development team. This role is critical to ensuring our formulation records, testing documentation, and regulatory compliance materials meet the rigorous standards required in a GMP-regulated dietary supplement manufacturing environment. You'll work closely with R&D scientists, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation across new product development and formulation projects.


Key Responsibilities
  • Create, review, and maintain R&D documentation including formulation records, batch development reports, stability study documentation, and analytical testing records
  • Draft and revise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), specifications, and technical protocols in support of new product development
  • Ensure documentation complies with 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplement cGMPs) and other applicable food/supplement regulations
  • Maintain version control and organization of R&D documents within document management systems
  • Support formulation IP documentation and ingredient traceability records
  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams to prepare documentation for internal audits, customer diligence requests, and regulatory inspections
  • Translate technical/scientific data into clear, structured written documentation for cross-functional stakeholders
  • Assist in preparing technical write-ups for new product bids, formulation change requests, and label/claims substantiation files

    • Required Qualifications
    • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a closely related scientific field
    • 2+ years of experience in a regulated food, dietary supplement, or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment
    • Hands-on experience with GMP documentation (batch records, SOPs, specifications, deviation/CAPA reports)
    • Strong technical writing skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
    • Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 111 or equivalent regulatory frameworks
    • Proficiency with document control systems (QMS/eDMS) or highly organized file management practices
    • Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills
    • English-speaking


    Preferred Qualifications
    • Degree or coursework in Nutrition/Dietetics (a plus for label claims and nutrient substantiation work)
    • Experience specifically in gummy, confectionery, or nutraceutical/dietary supplement R&D
    • Familiarity with formulation software or LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems)
    • Experience supporting audits, customer diligence, or regulatory inspections
    • Exposure to ingredient traceability and supply chain documentation
    What We Offer
    • Competitive Compensation
    • Opportunity to work at the intersection of science and product innovation in a growing nutraceutical manufacturing company
    • Collaborative, fast-paced R&D environment with direct impact on product development

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Banco de Talentos - Afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD/PwD) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Banco de Talentos - Afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD/PwD)


A Cyncly é construída a partir de marcas, que juntas, somam mais de 35 anos de experiência, fornecendo soluções especializadas de projetos, vendas, fabricação e conteúdo para clientes que desejam dar vida aos espaços. Nosso negócio abrange as indústrias de cozinha, banheiros, móveis, pisos, janelas, portas e vidros. As operações da Cyncly estão presentes na América do Norte, Europa, América do Sul, Ásia-Pacífico e África, tornando-se uma potência mundial e líder neste segmento.


O banco de talentos é aberto a todas as pessoas com deficiência que buscam novas oportunidades de carreira. Valorizamos a diversidade de experiências, habilidades e formações acadêmicas. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e está em busca de novos desafios, queremos conhecê-lo!


Como Funciona:

  • Inscrição no Banco de Talentos: Os candidatos interessados devem anexar seu currículo e completar a inscrição no Banco de Talentos.
  • Análise de Perfil: Revisaremos o perfil de cada candidato para identificar compatibilidade com as oportunidades disponíveis e possíveis ajustes necessários para acessibilidade no ambiente de trabalho. Possuímos oportunidades em diferentes áreas, híbridas, presenciais e remotas.
  • Entrevistas e Avaliações: Os candidatos selecionados serão convidados para entrevistas e avaliações, adaptados às suas necessidades.
  • Oportunidades: Quando surgir uma vaga que se alinhe ao perfil do candidato, entraremos em contato para discutir sobre a oportunidade.
  • Desenvolvimento e Acompanhamento: Onboarding e programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento, além de acompanhamento para garantir que todas as necessidades de acessibilidade e inclusão sejam atendidas.


O que oferecemos:

  • Plano de Saúde nacional Unimed ou Sulamérica - a depender da tua região (estendido aos seus dependentes);
  • Plano Odontológico nacional Unimed ou Sulamérica - a depender da tua região(estendido aos seus dependentes);
  • Alelo Tudo (você pode dividir o valor da melhor forma pra você, entre alimentação e refeição!);
  • Gympass;
  • ZenKlub;
  • Auxílio home office (para contratos remotos) ou vale transporte para contratos presenciais/híbridos;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Auxílio educação para Graduação, Pós Graduação | MBA | Mestrado | Doutorado, auxílio idiomas, acesso a plataformas de educação corporativa globais (como Linkedin Learning, Cyncly Academy) e ainda disponibilizamos de verba para treinamentos, cursos e workshops que estejam relacionados a sua área de atuação;
  • Convênios com farmácias, restaurantes e GNC Cinemas;
  • Convênios com instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idioma;
  • Day Off no mês do seu aniversário como presente;
  • Seguro de Vida Prudential;
  • Equipamentos de trabalho fornecidos pela empresa;
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados) anual;
  • Cyncly Store - compras facilitadas para itens corporativos;
  • Break saudável: na nossa unidade de Caxias do Sul, você encontra frutas da estação à disposição, máquina de café e máquina de snacks. Temos uma ampla área de lazer com jogos de mesa e o nosso Hub Garden onde você pode relaxar e conversar com os seus colegas.


Essa é uma vaga para o nosso Banco de Talentos - Exclusivo para PCD’s. Ao se inscrever você será considerado para futuras oportunidades em nossa empresa que correspondam ao seu perfil e habilidades.


Venha fazer parte da Cyncly!

title: Supply Chain | Transportes Oracle Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supply Chain | Transportes Oracle Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalh

Projeto completo de implantação de TMS, desde o levantamento de requisitos até o Go Live.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área de Transportes e Supply Chain.
  • Vivência em grandes embarcadores ou consultorias especializadas em Supply Chain.
  • Participação em, no mínimo, 3 projetos completos de implantação de TMS, desde o levantamento de requisitos até o Go Live.
  • Experiência com auditoria e conciliação de fretes.
  • Conhecimento sólido em CT-e (Conhecimento de Transporte Eletrônico) e legislação de transporte rodoviário.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação e sustentação de TMS.
  • Conhecimento em integração entre TMS e ERP.
  • Atuação em processos de transportes e logística.
  • Será considerado um diferencial
  • Conhecimento sobre a Reforma Tributária aplicada ao transporte.
  • Vivência com SPED Fiscal, NF-e e demais processos fiscais relacionados ao transporte.


Onde você vai trabalhar

title: Ecommerce Designer (Landing Pages)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ecommerce Designer (Landing Pages) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a hands-on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Landing Page Specialist (Shopify) who is both a builder and an analyst. You'll design and build high-converting landing pages for paid media and influencer campaigns, while continuously optimizing website performance based on user behavior data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is comfortable working with a company whose Christian, pro-life values are reflected in its mission and culture.

⏰ Part-time – 10–15 hours per week (US morning hours – ET)

LATAM-based candidates

Independent Contractor – USD Salary


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build 10–15 new landing page concepts per month using a visual page builder, plus make quick edits to existing templates (influencer swaps, offer changes).
  • Publish and manage landing pages in Shopify.
  • Analyze website and landing page performance (traffic, conversion rate, heatmaps) and provide weekly insights with actionable recommendations.
  • Own the A/B testing roadmap, including hypothesis creation, execution, analysis, and documentation.
  • Participate in a daily 15-minute team meeting at 10:30 AM ET .


Requirements

  • Proven experience building landing pages using a visual builder such as Replo, PageFly, Shogun, GemPages, Webflow, Framer, Unbounce , or similar. (We use Replo and will help you ramp up.)
  • Experience with Shopify and DTC/e-commerce brands .
  • Strong analytical skills using Google Analytics, Shopify Analytics , and heatmap tools such as Hotjar or Microsoft Clarity .
  • Portfolio showcasing landing pages you've built (required ).
  • Strong written English, including the ability to write on-page copy.
  • Availability during US morning hours (ET).
  • Comfortable working in a Christian, pro-life organization where these values are reflected in the company's mission and culture.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Replo .
  • Experience with A/B testing tools such as VWO or Optimizely .
  • Exposure to email marketing and customer retention strategies.

title: Planejador Financeiro / Consultor de Investimentos (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro / Consultor de Investimentos (Pessoa Física) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Information Technology Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior IT Business Analyst

Role Overview

The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.

The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.
  • Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.
  • Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.
  • Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.
  • Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.
  • Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.
  • Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.
  • Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.
  • Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.
  • Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications

Education and Experience


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.
  • Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.
  • General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.
  • Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.
  • Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.


Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.
  • Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.


Technical Expectations

The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.

Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist


Who We Are:

Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.


Your Role:

As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.


You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk

or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.


Why this role matters:

Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.


Responsibilities:

  • Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.

title: Planejador financeiro
description:

A TKC Capital está expandindo sua área de Planejamento Patrimonial, Planejamento Financeiro e Proteção Patrimonial e busca profissionais que desejam construir uma carreira de longo prazo em um ambiente sofisticado, meritocrático e orientado à alta performance.

Somos um Multi Family Office independente que integra investimentos, planejamento financeiro, crédito estruturado, proteção patrimonial, planejamento tributário e ativos imobiliários de alto padrão em uma única plataforma.

Nosso propósito é oferecer soluções patrimoniais completas para clientes que exigem excelência.


Por que a TKC?


A maioria das instituições financeiras limita seus profissionais a uma única vertical de negócios.

Na TKC, você passa a atuar em um ecossistema integrado, capaz de atender praticamente todas as demandas patrimoniais de um cliente, fortalecendo relacionamentos, aumentando o ticket médio e ampliando significativamente seu potencial de geração de receita.


Você terá acesso a soluções em:


• Gestão Patrimonial e Investimentos

• Planejamento Financeiro

• Planejamento Tributário Estratégico

• Crédito Estruturado e Imobiliário

• Proteção Patrimonial (Seguros)

• Mercado Imobiliário Premium


Enquanto muitos profissionais precisam abrir mão de oportunidades por não possuírem determinada solução dentro da empresa em que trabalham, na TKC você entrega uma visão patrimonial completa, tornando-se muito mais relevante para seus clientes.


Você traz o relacionamento. A TKC entrega o ecossistema.


Grandes carreiras são construídas sobre confiança.

Sabemos que profissionais de alta performance desenvolvem relacionamentos ao longo de muitos anos. Por isso, criamos uma estrutura para que você possa dedicar seu tempo ao que realmente importa: atender clientes, gerar negócios e construir patrimônio.

Enquanto você se dedica ao relacionamento e à estratégia, a TKC oferece toda a estrutura necessária para transformar oportunidades em soluções completas.


Você contará com um backoffice especializado em:


• Operações e formalização

• Planejamento Financeiro

• Investimentos

• Crédito Estruturado e Imobiliário

• Seguros e Proteção Patrimonial

• Planejamento Tributário

• Mercado Imobiliário Premium

• Compliance e Suporte Operacional


Nosso papel é permitir que você atenda seus clientes com a estrutura, o suporte técnico e a especialização normalmente encontrados apenas nos grandes Multi Family Offices, sem precisar construir essa operação do zero.


Uma carreira construída por mérito


Na TKC, crescimento não depende de tempo de casa nem de política corporativa.

Nossa trilha de evolução é objetiva, transparente e baseada exclusivamente em performance.


Analista Patrimonial → Executivo Patrimonial → Executivo Sênior → Executivo Principal


Cada evolução representa aumento de responsabilidades, expansão da liderança e crescimento do percentual de comissionamento, podendo chegar a 40% sobre o honorário líquido, além da oportunidade de desenvolver sua própria equipe e evoluir para posições estratégicas dentro do ecossistema TKC.


Quem buscamos


Esta oportunidade foi desenhada especialmente para profissionais que já atuam ou atuaram em:

• Assessoria de Investimentos

• Private Banking

• Segmento Alta Renda ou Empresas

• Planejamento Financeiro

• Wealth Management

• Crédito Estruturado

• Seguros Patrimoniais

Mais do que experiência, buscamos profissionais que entendam que relacionamento é patrimônio, tenham visão de longo prazo e desejem construir uma carreira baseada em confiança, excelência e geração de valor para seus clientes.



Nosso modelo de remuneração


Acreditamos que profissionais de alta performance devem ser remunerados pelo valor que geram.

Por isso, esta posição não oferece salário fixo, ajuda de custo ou remuneração mínima garantida.

A remuneração é 100% variável, composta por comissões recorrentes e progressivas sobre os negócios desenvolvidos.

title: PV Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PV Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ONDE O SOL NASCE


A Virto Solar é uma empresa pioneira no setor de energia solar, especializada no desenvolvimento de software para projetos solares de grande escala, comerciais e industriais. Por meio de produtos como Virto.CAD, Virto.MAX e Virto.CORE, ajudamos empresas de EPC, desenvolvedores, consultores e empresas de energia a projetar e otimizar projetos fotovoltaicos com mais rapidez e eficiência, do projeto de layout à otimização da produção.


SEU LUGAR AO SOL


À medida que a demanda por energia solar cresce em toda a América Latina, estamos expandindo nossa presença no Brasil e buscando um Engenheiro de PV com sólida formação técnica para apoiar a entrega de projetos de engenharia solar em toda a região.

Esta é uma função com foco em engenharia, trabalhando com desenvolvedores, EPCs e proprietários de ativos nas áreas de projeto de sistemas, análise técnica, suporte a projetos e entrega de engenharia.

Você combinará:

  • Conhecimento técnico de sistemas solares e de energia
  • Estratégia comercial
  • Gestão de relacionamento com o cliente
  • Inovação em energia renovável

Ideal para profissionais de:

  • Empresas de EPC solar
  • Empresas de engenharia fotovoltaica
  • Consultorias em energia renovável
  • Formação em engenharia elétrica ou mecânica
  • Equipes de projeto e desenvolvimento de energia solar
  • Empresas de software de energia / SaaS

ONDE VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR


  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de crescimento em todo o mercado solar brasileiro
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas: prospecção, demonstrações, negociações e fechamento de negócios
  • Estabelecer relações com desenvolvedores de projetos solares, empresas de EPC, escritórios de engenharia e empresas do setor de energia
  • Realizar demonstrações técnicas de produtos adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de mercado no setor de energia renovável
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto e engenharia para alinhar o feedback dos clientes com o desenvolvimento de produtos
  • Acompanhar as tendências de mercado em:
  • Energia solar fotovoltaica
  • Projetos em escala de concessionária
  • Energia solar comercial e industrial (C&I)
  • Sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias (BESS)
  • Software de energia
  • Manter um alto nível de satisfação do cliente e parcerias de longo prazo
  • Fornecer previsões e insights comerciais à liderança


SEUS RAIOS DE EXPERTISE


  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica, Energias Renováveis, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas de software B2B, de preferência no setor de energias renováveis ou solar, SaaS ou tecnologias limpas
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como PVsyst, AutoCAD, Helioscope, Aurora Solar, PVcase, SketchUp, GIS ou outras ferramentas de análise de terreno, diagramas elétricos unifilares ou fluxos de trabalho de projeto solar em escala de concessionária

  • Perfil proativo e analítico, à vontade para trabalhar remotamente

  • Trabalho de impacto: ajude a desenvolver produtos que contribuem diretamente para o futuro da energia solar e da sustentabilidade
  • Tecnologia de ponta: trabalhe com as tecnologias mais recentes em energia solar e software
  • Ambiente colaborativo: cultura centrada no trabalho em equipe, com inovação, aprendizado e crescimento em primeiro plano

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos: alinhados com sua experiência

title: SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler)

  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e apresentações executivas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos relacionados a:
  • Migração e saneamento de dados;
  • Integrações SAP e sistemas legados;
  • Performance, alta disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas SAP, recomendações oficiais e padrões corporativos de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes funcionais e técnicas na tomada de decisões arquiteturais ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos.


Requisitos:


  • Certificação SAP PCA (perfil SAP Basis).
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator - Portuguese em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Lead em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About PerkUp

PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.com.


We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.


This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.


The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.


This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations.
  • Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy.
  • Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability.
  • Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix.
  • Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls.
  • Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.


What success looks like

  • Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably.
  • Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors.
  • Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence.
  • PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.


What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment.
  • A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator.
  • Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.
  • Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.
  • Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.
  • A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.
  • Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.
  • Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.


Role details

  • Location: Remote, Latin America
  • Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time
  • Engagement: Full-time contractor
  • $4,500–$5,000 USD per month


Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supply Chain | Transportes Oracle Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

title: Arquitetura Azure
description:

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Azure).

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM
  • Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture
  • Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra
  • Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling
  • Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud
  • Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono
  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding
  • Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas
  • Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.


Desejável:


  • Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção
  • Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS
  • ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas células
  • Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço
  • Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula
  • Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
