title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense


About the Engagement

A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.


What You Will Own

  • Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.

  • Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.
  • Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.
  • Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.

  • Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.

Required Experience

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Headshots Retoucher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Headshots Retoucher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description:

About Us

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.


Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.


Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images


Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality


Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strict adherence to non-destructive workflows (expert use of adjustment layers, layer masks, and smart objects; zero destructive pixel editing)


Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)


Volume, Timing & Pay

  • $5 USD per image
  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days


Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:


Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior VIP Relationship Specialist to join our VIP team in Brazil. In this senior role, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for our high-value clients in the region. You will be responsible for elevating the customer experience, fostering long-term client loyalty, and leading localized initiatives to drive business success and market share within the Brazilian and broader LATAM crypto ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Management & Acquisition: Drive client acquisition and deliver high-touch relationship management for a dedicated portfolio of premium institutional and high-net-worth (HNW) clients in Brazil.
  • Relationship & Engagement: Build strong rapport and trust with existing VIP clients through frequent, personalized, and sustained communication, ensuring high retention and platform loyalty.
  • Process Optimization: Take ownership of designing and optimizing key customer service processes and systems tailored to the local market, establishing management rules, and tracking the life-cycle status of key accounts.
  • Data-Driven Analysis: Analyze client trading behaviors, identify unspoken or sophisticated needs, and prepare comprehensive key customer analysis reports to inform localized product and service strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the strategic liaison between Brazil VIP clients and internal stakeholders (Product, Compliance, Operations, and Tech teams) to deliver optimal, seamless, and compliant service solutions.

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: A well-established client network in Brazil/LATAM, including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), family offices, private banking clients, brokers, or futures institutions.
  • Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous.
  • Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.
  • Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.

title: Analista de Faturamento Pleno/Sênior (Vaga Temporária)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Faturamento Pleno/Sênior (Vaga Temporária) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Outsorce: Apoiamos as organizações em todas as etapas de sua jornada de terceirização de RH e folha de pagamento, ajudando-as a operar em conformidade com as normas, de forma eficiente e em grande escala. Nossa mais recente captação de recursos, no valor de 500 milhões de euros, tem como objetivo acelerar nosso crescimento e nossa expansão internacional. Nossa meta é dobrar nossa receita em cinco anos e nos tornarmos líderes mundiais em transformação digital de RH. A HR Path é uma empresa global de consultoria em RH. Oferecemos assessoria profissional e apoio a organizações para as quais o capital humano é essencial em seu processo de transformação de RH. Com presença nas Américas, na Europa e na Ásia-Pacífico, podemos oferecer suporte global no desenvolvimento e na execução da estratégia de RH de nossos clientes.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Receber e interpretar informações de faturamento provenientes das áreas internas (comercial, projetos, operações), garantindo precisão e completude dos dados
  • Criar e gerenciar Ordens de Venda no SAP , assegurando o correto preenchimento de todos os campos obrigatórios (cliente, material, condições de pagamento, centros de custo, etc.)
  • Executar o processo de faturamento no SAP (emissão de NF-e / NFS-e), garantindo conformidade fiscal e tributária
  • Realizar o cancelamento, estorno ou correção de documentos fiscais quando necessário, dentro dos prazos legais


Portais de Clientes e Submissão de Notas Fiscais


  • Realizar o upload e submissão de notas fiscais nos portais eletrônicos dos clientes (plataformas como Ariba, Coupa, portais proprietários, entre outros)
  • Monitorar o status de aprovação e pagamento das notas submetidas nos portais
  • Identificar e tratar recusas, inconsistências ou bloqueios nos portais, atuando em conjunto com as áreas de suporte e cliente quando necessário
  • Manter atualizado o cadastro de clientes e requisitos específicos de cada portal


Certificação e Validação das Informações


  • Verificar a acurácia das informações fiscais (CNPJ, endereço, tributação, alíquotas, NCM, CFOP) antes da emissão de cada documento fiscal
  • Validar a aderência contratual entre o que está sendo faturado e o que foi acordado com o cliente (escopo, valor, periodicidade)
  • Conferir dados bancários e condições de pagamento registrados no SAP antes da emissão da nota
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos de faturamento definidos no calendário mensal e nas obrigações contratuais


Conciliação e Controle


  • Realizar a conciliação entre o SAP e o sistema interno (DASH) , identificando e tratando divergências de valores, competências e lançamentos
  • Efetuar a conciliação com a Prefeitura (portal ISS / NFS-e municipal), garantindo que todas as notas emitidas estejam devidamente registradas e sem pendências junto ao município
  • Controlar o ciclo completo do faturamento : da emissão da ordem até a liquidação do título em aberto

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Immigration Paralegal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Busca-se candidato altamente detalhista para trabalhar como Paralegal de processos imigratórios, especificamente: Asilo, VAWA, visto U, visto T, SIJS e procedimentos perante a EOIR .


Esta oportunidade é remota (do Brasil), em tempo integral, e envolve contato direto com clientes internacionais, análise documental complexa e preparação de petições e formulários em inglês.


Requisitos :

  • Fluência em inglês.
  • 24 meses de experiência prática em imigração humanitária (Asilo, VAWA, U Visa, T Visa, SIJS, e audiências EOIR).
  • Excelente organização, atenção aos detalhes e gerenciamento de prazos.
  • Capacidade de redigir e revisar documentos legais em inglês.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação com clientes e equipe.


Espera-se que o profissional tenha experiência prática e autonomia para gerenciar casos humanitários , identificar necessidades processuais e possíveis formas de alívio, definir os filings e motions aplicáveis e antecipar os próximos passos, preparando cada caso de forma estratégica e completa para revisão e aprovação do advogado responsável.


Responsabilidades :

  • Gerenciar de forma autônoma um portfólio ativo de casos, conduzindo cada processo de ponta a ponta até sua preparação para protocolo.
  • Identificar necessidades processuais, formas de alívio, filings e motions aplicáveis, antecipando os próximos passos de cada caso.
  • Gerenciar prazos processuais e internos.
  • Conduzir entrevistas e comunicação com clientes de forma clara e empática.
  • Redigir affidavits, motions e outros documentos legais em inglês.
  • Preparar e revisar formulários e filings perante USCIS e EOIR.
  • Analisar, solicitar e organizar pacote de evidências e exhibits.
  • Manter os casos organizados, atualizados e em conformidade com os padrões de confidencialidade do escritório.

Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede.

  • Pricing, billing, contratos e integrações

  • CCM (Condition Contract Management)

  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA (on-premise, Private e Public Cloud).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas SAP e processos end-to-end integrados.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em EWM (Extended Warehouse Management);
  • Experiência com soluções avançadas de Supply Chain;
  • Conhecimentos em SAP BTP, extensões e integrações;
  • Vivência anterior em pré-vendas (solutioning, propostas, POCs, estimativas).



Competências comportamentais

  • Excelente comunicação e interação com stakeholders executivos;

  • Perfil consultivo, com empatia para compreender desafios do cliente e propor soluções adequadas;

title: Especialista jurídico
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista jurídico em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão

Assegurar que toda a operação de cobrança extrajudicial e judicial esteja em conformidade com a legislação vigente, garantindo segurança jurídica aos processos, mitigação de riscos e preservação da capacidade de recuperação de crédito. Atuar como referência técnica na estruturação, validação e melhoria dos fluxos de cobrança, preparando os casos para eventual judicialização e apoiando a empresa na tomada de decisões estratégicas relacionadas à recuperação de crédito.



Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar e validar juridicamente toda a jornada de cobrança extrajudicial e judicial, assegurando conformidade legal e mitigação de riscos;
  • Elaborar pareceres jurídicos relacionados à recuperação de crédito, inadimplência, garantias, contratos e estratégias de execução;
  • Definir requisitos jurídicos para preparação dos casos destinados à judicialização, assegurando robustez documental e preservação da exigibilidade dos créditos;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução das políticas de crédito, cobrança e recuperação de ativos sob a perspectiva jurídica;
  • Revisar e evoluir réguas de cobrança, notificações, acordos, comunicações e documentos jurídicos utilizados na operação;
  • Estruturar fluxos jurídicos padronizados, controles internos e procedimentos que aumentem segurança, rastreabilidade e eficiência operacional;
  • Participar da definição de estratégias jurídicas para novos produtos, serviços e operações estruturadas de crédito;
  • Atuar na implementação e evolução de ferramentas jurídicas (LegalTechs), apoiando a digitalização e automação dos processos da área;
  • Definir requisitos jurídicos para integrações sistêmicas, automações e novos fluxos operacionais;
  • Estruturar indicadores (KPIs), dashboards e controles gerenciais para acompanhamento da performance jurídica e da recuperação de crédito;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Produto, Operações e Engenharia na construção de soluções escaláveis e juridicamente sustentáveis;
  • Avaliar riscos jurídicos de novas estratégias comerciais e operacionais, propondo alternativas que conciliem segurança jurídica e eficiência do negócio;

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Product Designer (3-Month Contract)

Location: Remote


My client is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join their team on a 3-month contract, helping deliver high-impact improvements across key customer journeys and core product experiences.


This is a hands-on execution role suited to a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, can work independently with minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex UX challenges through thoughtful, polished design. You'll work closely with product and engineering teams to rapidly validate ideas, improve user experiences, and deliver production-ready designs that create measurable business impact.


You'll be involved in a variety of optimisation and product enhancement initiatives, including:

  • Improving cross-sell and upsell journeys to create seamless customer experiences.
  • Leading discovery and design work for subscription management features, from research through to high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conducting user interviews, usability testing, competitor analysis, and reviewing customer feedback to inform design decisions.
  • Enhancing landing pages and core product experiences to support international growth.
  • Improving authentication and account management user journeys.
  • Supporting additional product design initiatives as priorities evolve throughout the engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive, user-centred experiences across web and product platforms.
  • Rapidly design, prototype and iterate production-ready user interfaces that balance user needs with business outcomes.
  • Create high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Work within and extend an established design system, creating scalable, reusable components rather than one-off solutions.
  • Use analytics, funnel data, customer feedback, support insights and qualitative research to identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to deliver features efficiently.
  • Take ownership of design challenges with minimal supervision, working from high-level objectives rather than detailed specifications.
  • Balance speed and quality while managing multiple priorities within a fixed delivery timeline.


Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years' commercial Product Design experience, ideally within SaaS or digital products.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, UX thinking and systems-based design.
  • Experience designing customer-facing B2C products and digital experiences.
  • Advanced Figma skills, including component libraries, prototyping and design systems.
  • Commercial experience working within and extending design systems using a component-first approach.
  • Commercial experience using AI-powered design and prototyping tools (Claude Design preferred).
  • Strong understanding of user research methodologies, usability testing and data-informed design.
  • Experience using analytics, funnel data, customer feedback and support insights to prioritise UX improvements.
  • Experience delivering high-quality design work within fast-paced product environments using lightweight processes.
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal direction and turning high-level objectives into production-ready designs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Desirable

  • Experience working within subscription-based or SaaS products.
  • Experience optimising conversion funnels and customer journeys.
  • Familiarity with internationalisation and localisation considerations.
  • Experience working within agile product teams.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Ecommerce em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company: Lime Vizio Inc.

Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)

Location: Remote (outside the US)

Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours

Reports to: CEO & Founders


About Lime Vizio

Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.

We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own

  • E-commerce growth strategy
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Customer journey & UX
  • Merchandising & pricing
  • Checkout optimization
  • A/B testing & experimentation
  • Retention (Email & SMS)
  • SEO commercial performance
  • AI-powered shopping experiences
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor.
  • Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap.
  • Lead CRO and experimentation programs.
  • Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile.
  • Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells.
  • Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth.
  • Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.


Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

  • Gross Profit
  • Profit per Visitor
  • Conversion Rate
  • Average Order Value
  • Checkout Completion
  • Repeat Purchase Rate
  • Customer Lifetime Value
  • Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements

  • 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce.
  • 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role.
  • Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required).
  • Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability.
  • Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams.
  • Excellent English (B2+).
  • Available during Los Angeles business hours.
  • Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-brand e-commerce
  • Marketplace businesses
  • High-volume online retail
  • WooCommerce or Shopify
  • AI-powered personalization
  • Behavioral psychology
  • Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who

  • Only manages website content.
  • Focuses on traffic instead of profit.
  • Relies entirely on agencies.
  • Treats CRO as visual redesign.
  • Reports problems without owning implementation.
  • Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer

  • Remote, long-term leadership role.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO and founders.
  • Ownership of commercial growth strategy.
  • Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.


Equal Employment Opportunity

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Ecommerce em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company: Lime Vizio Inc.

Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)

Location: Remote (outside the US)

Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours

Reports to: CEO & Founders


About Lime Vizio

Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.

We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own

  • E-commerce growth strategy
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Customer journey & UX
  • Merchandising & pricing
  • Checkout optimization
  • A/B testing & experimentation
  • Retention (Email & SMS)
  • SEO commercial performance
  • AI-powered shopping experiences
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor.
  • Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap.
  • Lead CRO and experimentation programs.
  • Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile.
  • Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells.
  • Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth.
  • Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.


Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

  • Gross Profit
  • Profit per Visitor
  • Conversion Rate
  • Average Order Value
  • Checkout Completion
  • Repeat Purchase Rate
  • Customer Lifetime Value
  • Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements

  • 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce.
  • 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role.
  • Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required).
  • Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability.
  • Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams.
  • Excellent English (B2+).
  • Available during Los Angeles business hours.
  • Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-brand e-commerce
  • Marketplace businesses
  • High-volume online retail
  • WooCommerce or Shopify
  • AI-powered personalization
  • Behavioral psychology
  • Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who

  • Only manages website content.
  • Focuses on traffic instead of profit.
  • Relies entirely on agencies.
  • Treats CRO as visual redesign.
  • Reports problems without owning implementation.
  • Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer

  • Remote, long-term leadership role.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO and founders.
  • Ownership of commercial growth strategy.
  • Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: AI Filmmaker - Especialista em Criação de Videos com IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Filmmaker - Especialista em Criação de Videos com IA em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) AI Filmmaker inovador(a), especializado(a) na criação de vídeos cinematográficos e fotorrealistas utilizando ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e fluxos de produção híbridos. Esta posição combina os fundamentos da produção audiovisual tradicional com expertise em tecnologias de IA aplicadas à criação de vídeo. O(a) profissional ideal possui domínio de cinematografia, iluminação, linguagem de câmera, edição e narrativa visual, aliado a um profundo conhecimento de ferramentas de geração de vídeo por IA, fluxos de animação e pipelines de pós-produção. Inglês fluente é mandatório para esta vaga uma vez que trabalhamos em parceria com times internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conceber e produzir vídeos de alta qualidade gerados por IA com estética cinematográfica e realismo visual.
  • Transformar roteiros, storyboards e briefings criativos em narrativas audiovisuais impactantes.
  • Projetar e executar fluxos de produção baseados em IA, desde a pré-visualização até a entrega final.
  • Dirigir performances virtuais, ambientes digitais e movimentos de câmera dentro de plataformas de IA.
  • Aplicar princípios avançados de cinematografia, incluindo iluminação, composição, escolha de lentes, profundidade e dinâmica de movimento.
  • Garantir continuidade visual entre planos, cenas e sequências.
  • Integrar conteúdo gerado por IA com filmagens reais (live action), bancos de imagem e vídeo (stock footage), efeitos visuais (VFX) ou elementos 3D, quando necessário.
  • Gerenciar os processos de pós-produção, incluindo edição, correção de cor (color grading), integração de áudio e finalização.
  • Explorar continuamente novos modelos de IA para geração de vídeo, buscando otimizar qualidade, consistência e eficiência dos resultados.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com diretores de criação, editores, estrategistas e equipes de produção para garantir alinhamento entre visão criativa e execução.


Competências Técnicas e Qualificações

Expertise em Cinematografia e Narrativa Visual

  • Sólido domínio da linguagem cinematográfica, incluindo composição de planos, blocking, ritmo, enquadramentos e narrativa visual.
  • Experiência em desenho de iluminação para diferentes estilos, como naturalista, estúdio e cinematográfico.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de câmera, lentes e estilos de movimentação (dolly, handheld, Steadicam e estética de drone).
  • Capacidade de manter coerência narrativa, continuidade visual e impacto emocional em sequências geradas por IA.
  • Excelente senso de edição, ritmo e estrutura narrativa.


Domínio de IA e Ferramentas Técnicas

  • Experiência com as principais plataformas de geração de vídeo por IA.
  • Domínio de técnicas avançadas de prompt engineering para controle de movimento, composição e direção de cenas.
  • Conhecimento sobre consistência temporal, continuidade de personagens e métodos de controle de cenas.
  • Experiência com fluxos de trabalho envolvendo compositing, inpainting, upscaling e interpolação de quadros (frame interpolation).
  • Proficiência em softwares de edição de vídeo.
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de color grading e acabamento cinematográfico.
  • Familiaridade com a integração de conteúdos gerados por IA em fluxos tradicionais de pós-produção.


Experiência Desejável

  • Formação ou experiência em cinema, produção audiovisual, cinematografia ou produção publicitária.
  • Vivência em publicidade, branded content, campanhas para mídias sociais ou produções de curta duração.
  • Conhecimento de fluxos de trabalho com efeitos visuais (VFX) e composição de movimento.
  • Compreensão de aspectos éticos, direitos autorais e licenciamento relacionados à produção de conteúdo com IA.
  • Experiência na criação de processos escaláveis e reutilizáveis para produção de vídeos utilizando Inteligência Artificial.


Competências Comportamentais

  • Forte visão criativa aliada à excelência técnica.
  • Alto nível de atenção aos detalhes, especialmente em continuidade de movimento e realismo visual.
  • Capacidade de iterar rapidamente sem comprometer a clareza narrativa e a qualidade da produção.
  • Facilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, acompanhando a rápida evolução das tecnologias de IA.
  • Boa comunicação, sendo capaz de explicar e defender decisões criativas e técnicas de forma clara e objetiva.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Customer Service Representative

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist


Who We Are:

Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.


Your Role:

As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.


You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk

or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.


Why this role matters:

Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.


Responsibilities:

  • Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.


  • Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.


  • Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.


  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.


  • Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.


  • Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard


What We’re Looking For:

Must-haves:

  • Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one.
  • Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility.
  • Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone.
  • Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants.
  • Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection.
  • Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product.
  • Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows.
  • Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

Esta posição híbrida combina expertise em edição de vídeo, motion graphics e animação para produzir conteúdos envolventes e de alta qualidade para diferentes públicos e plataformas. O(a) profissional ideal domina tanto a construção de uma narrativa por meio da edição quanto o desenvolvimento de animações sofisticadas e motion graphics. Possui excelente senso de storytelling, ritmo, composição visual e atenção aos detalhes, além de profundo conhecimento técnico em fluxos de pós-produção. Trabalhando em parceria com diretores de criação, produtores e equipes multidisciplinares, será responsável por transformar conceitos criativos e materiais brutos em entregas prontas para produção, atendendo aos mais altos padrões de qualidade. Inglês fluente é mandatório para esta vaga uma vez que trabalhamos em parceria com times internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Editar conteúdos audiovisuais de alta qualidade para campanhas digitais, redes sociais, experiências imersivas, eventos ao vivo e ações de marketing, utilizando Adobe Premiere Pro e o ecossistema Adobe Creative Cloud .
  • Criar motion graphics, animações, títulos animados, vídeos explicativos, animações de interfaces (UI) e outros elementos visuais utilizando Adobe After Effects e Cinema 4D .
  • Montar e refinar vídeos a partir de filmagens brutas, bancos de imagem e vídeo (stock), elementos gráficos, narrações (voice-over) e trilhas sonoras, construindo narrativas visuais envolventes.
  • Desenvolver animações e edições com base em diretrizes criativas, roteiros, storyboards, style frames e guias de identidade visual, mantendo alto padrão técnico e criativo.
  • Refinar ritmo, timing, transições, tipografia, áudio e detalhes visuais para entregar materiais finalizados com excelência.
  • Realizar correção de cor (color correction), tratamento de áudio, mixagem básica e demais processos de finalização na pós-produção.
  • Colaborar com designers, animadores, editores, produtores e diretores de criação para garantir entregas consistentes, eficientes e alinhadas aos objetivos dos projetos.
