title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth. 🚀

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

A maioria das instituições financeiras limita seus profissionais a uma única vertical de negócios.

title: PV Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PV Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ONDE O SOL NASCE


A Virto Solar é uma empresa pioneira no setor de energia solar, especializada no desenvolvimento de software para projetos solares de grande escala, comerciais e industriais. Por meio de produtos como Virto.CAD, Virto.MAX e Virto.CORE, ajudamos empresas de EPC, desenvolvedores, consultores e empresas de energia a projetar e otimizar projetos fotovoltaicos com mais rapidez e eficiência, do projeto de layout à otimização da produção.


SEU LUGAR AO SOL


À medida que a demanda por energia solar cresce em toda a América Latina, estamos expandindo nossa presença no Brasil e buscando um Engenheiro de PV com sólida formação técnica para apoiar a entrega de projetos de engenharia solar em toda a região.

Esta é uma função com foco em engenharia, trabalhando com desenvolvedores, EPCs e proprietários de ativos nas áreas de projeto de sistemas, análise técnica, suporte a projetos e entrega de engenharia.

Você combinará:

  • Conhecimento técnico de sistemas solares e de energia
  • Estratégia comercial
  • Gestão de relacionamento com o cliente
  • Inovação em energia renovável

Ideal para profissionais de:

  • Empresas de EPC solar
  • Empresas de engenharia fotovoltaica
  • Consultorias em energia renovável
  • Formação em engenharia elétrica ou mecânica
  • Equipes de projeto e desenvolvimento de energia solar
  • Empresas de software de energia / SaaS

ONDE VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR


  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de crescimento em todo o mercado solar brasileiro
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas: prospecção, demonstrações, negociações e fechamento de negócios
  • Estabelecer relações com desenvolvedores de projetos solares, empresas de EPC, escritórios de engenharia e empresas do setor de energia
  • Realizar demonstrações técnicas de produtos adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de mercado no setor de energia renovável
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto e engenharia para alinhar o feedback dos clientes com o desenvolvimento de produtos
  • Acompanhar as tendências de mercado em:
  • Energia solar fotovoltaica
  • Projetos em escala de concessionária
  • Energia solar comercial e industrial (C&I)
  • Sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias (BESS)
  • Software de energia
  • Manter um alto nível de satisfação do cliente e parcerias de longo prazo
  • Fornecer previsões e insights comerciais à liderança


SEUS RAIOS DE EXPERTISE


  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica, Energias Renováveis, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas de software B2B, de preferência no setor de energias renováveis ou solar, SaaS ou tecnologias limpas
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como PVsyst, AutoCAD, Helioscope, Aurora Solar, PVcase, SketchUp, GIS ou outras ferramentas de análise de terreno, diagramas elétricos unifilares ou fluxos de trabalho de projeto solar em escala de concessionária
  • Sólido conhecimento do mercado de energia renovável
  • Fluência em inglês e português; outros idiomas são um diferencial
  • Experiência com simulações de rendimento energético, layouts de usinas, dimensionamento de inversores/cadeias, sistemas de rastreamento, roteamento de cabos, otimização de CC/CA, conceitos de subestações ou conexão à rede é altamente valorizada
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e apresentação
  • Perfil proativo e analítico, à vontade para trabalhar remotamente
  • Forte paixão por energia solar e sustentabilidade



Por Que Você Vai Amar Trabalhar na Virto

  • Trabalho de impacto: ajude a desenvolver produtos que contribuem diretamente para o futuro da energia solar e da sustentabilidade
  • Tecnologia de ponta: trabalhe com as tecnologias mais recentes em energia solar e software
  • Ambiente colaborativo: cultura centrada no trabalho em equipe, com inovação, aprendizado e crescimento em primeiro plano
  • Ambiente orientado para a missão e de alto crescimento: junte-se a uma empresa em rápido crescimento com uma missão clara: acelerar a transição global para as energias renováveis
  • O melhor dos dois mundos: trabalho totalmente remoto com um forte senso de equipe por meio de uma excelente colaboração online
  • Exposição internacional: a oportunidade de viajar e representar a Virto Solar em um cenário internacional
  • Salário e benefícios competitivos: alinhados com sua experiência

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Ad Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere on EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Global Head of Customer Support
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Head of Customer Support em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client, a global leader in in food safety, compliance, and product integrity solutions, is seeking a Head of Customer Support. This role leads the strategy, performance, and customer experience of the global software support function within the Digital Solutions division. This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike. Will be working to support customers in over 100 countries and supporting product teams in the US, LATAM, EMEA , and APAC.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives.
  • Lead and develop the global support team across first, second, and advanced technical support and grow the function in line with portfolio growth.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management
  • Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance
  • Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering on defect lifecycle, prioritisation, customer communication, and feeding service insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers.
  • Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently.
  • Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including FreshService and equivalent service management platforms
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization
  • Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities.
  • Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within SaaS or software businesses.
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong technical acumen across SaaS architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases
  • Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence.
  • Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation.
  • Familiarity with FreshService or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale.
  • Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).


This is a CLT role R$40-50K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.

title: AI Sales Enablement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Sales Enablement Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Bradford Jacobs has partnered with a global technology manufacturer and service provider known for producing a broad range of computing devices and enterprise solutions, with customers spanning individuals, corporations, education, and government


About the Role

They are looking for an experienced Enterprise AI Sales Enablement Specialist to support the planning, coordination, and delivery of global sales training and certification programmes focused on enterprise AI solutions.


This role combines project management, learning operations, stakeholder engagement, event coordination, reporting, and programme administration. You will work closely with internal teams, external partners, and training providers to ensure enablement initiatives are delivered effectively and provide measurable business impact.


The successful candidate will be highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously within a fast-paced global environment.


Key Responsibilities

Programme & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary coordinator for enterprise AI sales enablement programmes.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external training partners to ensure programme objectives, milestones, and deadlines are achieved.
  • Maintain project plans, documentation, and governance processes to support successful programme delivery.
  • Monitor programme progress and proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies.


Budget, Funding & Vendor Administration

  • Support funding applications, approvals, and associated programme documentation.
  • Coordinate budget allocation and funding activities across learning initiatives.
  • Track programme expenditure, certification vouchers, and associated costs.
  • Monitor supplier and vendor expenses against budget forecasts.
  • Build effective working relationships with external training providers and partners.


Training & Certification Operations

  • Administer professional certification programmes, workshops, and specialist sales training.
  • Coordinate virtual and instructor-led training sessions, including scheduling, learning resources, labs, and facilitators.
  • Manage certification voucher ordering, distribution, tracking, and reconciliation.
  • Coordinate participant communications and scheduling across multiple regions and time zones.


Event & Logistics Management

  • Collaborate with learning, marketing, and business teams to promote enablement programmes and maximise participation.
  • Plan and deliver workshops, bootcamps, and multi-day training events.
  • Coordinate facilities, catering, travel arrangements, and event logistics where required.
  • Manage invitations, attendance tracking, and event execution.
  • Ensure all programme and event requirements are met in line with established standards.


Reporting & Programme Analytics

  • Create and maintain dashboards that measure programme effectiveness and learner engagement.
  • Track participation, certification achievements, completion rates, and training outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate programme records and reporting databases.
  • Reconcile external reporting with internal programme records.
  • Provide regular updates and insights to key stakeholders.


Compliance & Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain programme documentation and proof-of-execution records.
  • Compile participant information, completion metrics, training evaluations, and supporting evidence.
  • Ensure all programme documentation is audit-ready and compliant with internal requirements.
  • Support reporting and governance processes across learning initiatives.


Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in learning operations, sales enablement, project administration, programme coordination, or a related field.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Smartsheet.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Desirable

  • Experience supporting AI, technology, or enterprise sales enablement programmes.
  • Knowledge of certification programme administration.
  • Experience working with external vendors, training providers, and strategic partners.
  • Experience coordinating global programmes across multiple geographies and time zones.


Additional Information

  • No travel is required for this role.
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact global AI enablement initiatives supporting enterprise sales teams and business growth


Salary for this role is up to USD 97,000 per annum.


This is a B2B FTC based remotely within South America with an expectation to work close to EST working hours.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development & Marketing em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Technical Sales Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Sales Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Technical Sales Specialist – Construction Products


Location: Remote – Anywhere in LATAM

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Employment Type: Employee

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience


About the Role

We are seeking a technically knowledgeable professional to support customers with construction-related products, technical quotations, specifications, and project requirements.

This position combines technical analysis, estimating, customer communication, and sales support. The successful candidate will review project information, prepare accurate quotations, answer product-related questions, and help customers identify appropriate solutions.

This is a technical sales position rather than a general customer-service role. Training will be provided on the company’s products, quoting procedures, and sales processes.


Responsibilities
  • Review architectural drawings, measurements, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Prepare accurate technical quotations and pricing proposals.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or contradictory project information.
  • Communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements.
  • Explain product options, specifications, pricing, and project considerations clearly.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, and other internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate records of quotations, customer communications, and project updates.
  • Follow up on open quotations and support opportunities through the sales process.
  • Develop detailed knowledge of the company’s construction products and systems.
  • Provide professional support to customers primarily located in the United States.


Required Qualifications
  • Completed, or nearing completion of, a degree in a relevant technical field, such as:
  • Architecture
  • Civil engineering
  • Architectural engineering
  • Construction engineering
  • Industrial design
  • Product design involving physical products or building systems
  • A closely related engineering or construction discipline
  • Advanced professional English proficiency, approximately CEFR C1 or higher.
  • Ability to communicate naturally and confidently with customers in English.
  • Ability to explain technical information in a clear and organized manner.
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand drawings, dimensions, specifications, and product information.
  • Availability to work full-time during the established U.S. Eastern Time schedule.
  • Reliable computer, internet connection, webcam, and workspace suitable for professional calls and confidential business conversations.


Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

  • Construction or architectural-product estimating
  • Doors, windows, glass, glazing, cabinetry, millwork, or building materials
  • Reading construction drawings, plans, measurements, and specifications
  • Preparing technical quotations, estimates, or pricing proposals
  • Coordinating with customers, suppliers, purchasing, production, logistics, or installation teams
  • Technical sales, project coordination, or customer-facing construction roles

Previous experience with doors is helpful but not required.


Virtual-Office Environment

This position operates in a live, video-enabled virtual office during scheduled working hours. Team members are expected to keep their video enabled and remain available for real-time communication and collaboration, except during approved breaks, private conversations, or when an accommodation or applicable law requires otherwise.

Applicants should carefully consider this working arrangement before applying.


Interview Process

Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in an English-language video interview covering:

  • Technical education and relevant experience
  • Experience with drawings, specifications, estimating, or quotations
  • Problem-solving and project coordination
  • Interest in developing a technical sales career
  • Schedule, equipment, and virtual-office availability
  • Compensation expectations and potential start date

Applicants will be informed before any interview is recorded, and recordings will only be collected with their consent.


Equal Opportunity
  • We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available during the recruitment process and, where applicable, in the performance of the role.

title: Retocador de Imagens Especializado em IA – ***INGLÊS REQUERIDO***
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Retocador de Imagens Especializado em IA – ***INGLÊS REQUERIDO*** em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Artista de IA altamente qualificado(a), especializado(a) na criação de imagens realistas com qualidade fotográfica. Esta função combina visão artística com conhecimento técnico em composição de imagens, retoque e fluxos de produção baseados em inteligência artificial. O(a) profissional ideal possui um olhar apurado para iluminação, composição e narrativa visual, aliado a um profundo domínio de ferramentas de IA generativa e processos de refinamento de imagens.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar imagens fotorrealistas de alta qualidade utilizando ferramentas de geração de imagens por IA.
  • Traduzir briefs criativos em peças visuais impactantes e prontas para produção.

Competências e Qualificações


Expertise Artística e Visual

  • Olhar apurado para iluminação natural e artificial (estúdio, ambientes externos e linguagem cinematográfica).
  • Conhecimento avançado em composição, enquadramento, perspectiva e profundidade.
  • Domínio de sistemas de câmeras, lentes, distâncias focais e estética fotográfica.
  • Expertise em tratamento de cor (color grading), realismo e continuidade visual.
  • Capacidade de identificar e corrigir artefatos visuais ou inconsistências nas imagens.


Conhecimentos Técnicos e em IA

  • Experiência com as principais plataformas de IA generativa.
  • Forte domínio de engenharia de prompts voltada para geração de imagens fotorrealistas.
  • Familiaridade com ajuste de modelos (model tuning), sistemas de controle (como ControlNet, LoRA e referências de estilo) e fluxos de condicionamento de imagens será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de fluxos de trabalho relacionados à resolução de imagens, incluindo upscaling, inpainting, outpainting e retoque.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de pós-produção, como Photoshop, Lightroom ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de pipelines de produção, preparação de arquivos e padrões de entrega de ativos.


Experiência Desejada

  • Formação ou experiência em fotografia, cinematografia ou retoque de alto padrão.
  • Experiência em agências de publicidade, branding, editoriais ou produções comerciais.
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos de trabalho de IA escaláveis e reproduzíveis para produção criativa.


Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente senso estético e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de iterar rapidamente sem comprometer a qualidade.
  • Boa comunicação, com habilidade para justificar e apresentar decisões criativas.
  • Adaptabilidade e conforto para atuar em um ambiente em constante evolução, impulsionado pelas novas tecnologias de inteligência artificial.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You’ll Do
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace .
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos procurando um(a) Analista de Crédito para integrar nossa área de Produtos, atuando diretamente na evolução de uma solução proprietária de Inteligência Artificial voltada à análise de crédito corporativo.

O profissional será responsável por validar análises financeiras produzidas pela IA, identificar oportunidades de melhoria, estruturar regras de negócio e apoiar o desenvolvimento contínuo do produto.

Mais do que analisar balanços, será um especialista de negócio responsável por garantir que a inteligência artificial reproduza, de forma consistente, o raciocínio esperado de um analista de crédito experiente.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras de empresas de diferentes segmentos e portes;
  • Validar a consistência das extrações realizadas por modelos de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Comparar informações extraídas pela IA com demonstrações financeiras originais (PDFs);
  • Identificar inconsistências contábeis, classificações incorretas e oportunidades de melhoria dos modelos;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio para evolução da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Produto, Dados e Desenvolvimento na priorização de melhorias;
  • Apoiar a criação de novos indicadores financeiros e métricas de risco;
  • Participar da definição de metodologias de análise de crédito implementadas na solução;
  • Executar testes funcionais antes da disponibilização de novas versões do produto;
  • Apoiar demonstrações técnicas para clientes quando necessário;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua do motor de IA por meio da validação de resultados.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de crédito corporativo;


Conhecimento sólido em:

  • Balanço Patrimonial;
  • Demonstração do Resultado (DRE);
  • Demonstração dos Fluxos de Caixa (DFC);
  • Notas Explicativas;
  • Indicadores financeiros;
  • Liquidez;
  • Endividamento;
  • Rentabilidade;
  • Capital de Giro;
  • EBITDA;
  • Fluxo de Caixa;
  • Facilidade para identificar inconsistências contábeis e financeiras;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Excelente capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Experiência em utilização de sistemas de informação.
  • Bom conhecimento em utilização de sistemas Web.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em bancos, fintechs, bureaus de crédito ou áreas de risco corporativo;
  • Conhecimento de IFRS e CPCs;
  • Experiência com OCR, Inteligência Artificial ou Machine Learning aplicado ao mercado financeiro;
  • Vivência em testes funcionais (QA) de sistemas;
  • Conhecimento em SQL ou ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol avançado/fluente


Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos um profissional curioso, detalhista e orientado por dados, capaz de questionar resultados, investigar inconsistências e transformar conhecimento financeiro em inteligência para um produto de tecnologia.


Esperamos alguém que tenha facilidade para trabalhar de forma multidisciplinar, interagindo com especialistas de produto, cientistas de dados e desenvolvedores, contribuindo para a construção de uma solução inovadora baseada em Inteligência Artificial.

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

ü Good understanding of the market landscape.

ü Wide connections with end users like feed mills, premix companies, etc.

ü Wide connections with local feed-additive distributors.

ü Analytical and strategic development skills.

ü Work together with VEGA Group’s international team to achieve the annual sales target.

title: Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.


You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.


What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.

  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente
