title: Head of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Finance- Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business.


The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership

  • Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity.
  • Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives.
  • Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership.

Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations.
  • Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.

Treasury & Banking

  • Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships.
  • Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements.
  • Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities.
  • Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure.

Financial Controls & Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning.
  • Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals.
  • Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions.
  • Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements.
  • Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional \"fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.


Why Join VelaFi?

Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure.

As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil , you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations.


This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Head de Operações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head de Operações em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão

Liderar e desenvolver a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito de operações financeiras agrícolas, assegurando excelência na execução, segurança jurídica, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e geração de resultados.

Será responsável por estruturar uma operação altamente padronizada, auditável e orientada por dados, capaz de conduzir toda a jornada de recuperação de crédito — desde a cobrança preventiva e extrajudicial até a preparação dos casos para judicialização — preservando a exigibilidade dos créditos, a qualidade das evidências e a efetividade das estratégias adotadas.

Atuará como principal elo entre Operações, Jurídico, Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio, transformando desafios operacionais em processos, controles, automações e soluções tecnológicas. Buscamos uma liderança com forte capacidade de execução, profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para construir uma operação escalável por meio de dados, tecnologia, inteligência artificial e melhoria contínua.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito, garantindo produtividade, qualidade, segurança jurídica e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Definir a estratégia operacional das carteiras, considerando exposição financeira, estágio da inadimplência, perfil do devedor, garantias disponíveis e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Governar toda a jornada de recuperação, incluindo notificações, negociações, promessas de pagamento, acordos, protestos, negativação, baixas, gestão de garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar políticas, fluxos, procedimentos, critérios de priorização, níveis de alçada e controles internos;
  • Assegurar a rastreabilidade das ações de cobrança e a adequada formalização de contatos, propostas, acordos, pagamentos, garantias e demais evidências;
  • Garantir, em parceria com o Jurídico, que os casos encaminhados à judicialização estejam completos, fundamentados e documentalmente preparados, preservando a exigibilidade do crédito;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e dimensionar a equipe de acordo com o volume, a complexidade e as prioridades das carteiras, atuando também como referência técnica em casos críticos;
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de recuperação, produtividade, aging, acordos, promessas de pagamento, SLAs, custos e qualidade operacional;
  • Conduzir comitês de cobrança e elaborar análises executivas sobre resultados, riscos, estratégias adotadas e oportunidades de recuperação;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e ganho de escala, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em requisitos para Produto, Engenharia e fornecedores de tecnologia;
  • Aplicar dados e inteligência artificial na segmentação de carteiras, priorização de casos, recomendação de estratégias e controle da qualidade operacional;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, fundos, cedentes, escritórios jurídicos e parceiros especializados, assegurando alinhamento sobre estratégias, prazos e resultados.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações de cobrança extrajudicial e recuperação de crédito;
  • Vivência na gestão de carteiras inadimplentes de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos fluxos de cobrança, negociação, protesto, negativação, acordos, garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Experiência na estruturação, revisão e melhoria de processos operacionais;
  • Histórico de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance;
  • Experiência com indicadores, metas, SLAs e gestão orientada por dados;
  • Capacidade de análise de carteiras, definição de prioridades e construção de estratégias de recuperação;
  • Experiência em projetos de automação, implantação de sistemas ou transformação digital;
  • Boa interlocução com áreas Jurídica, Financeira, Produto e Engenharia;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica e, simultaneamente, acompanhar a execução operacional em profundidade.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio;
  • Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito;
  • Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas;
  • Familiaridade com CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais;
  • Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados;
  • Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança;
  • Vivência com LegalOps, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras;
  • Pós-graduação em Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.


Competências Esperadas

  • Liderança com forte orientação para execução;
  • Visão estratégica e pensamento sistêmico;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões em ambientes de pressão e incerteza;
  • Profundidade analítica e domínio de indicadores;
  • Excelente capacidade de negociação;
  • Comunicação clara, firme e executiva;
  • Disciplina de processos e atenção à qualidade;
  • Senso de urgência e capacidade de priorização;
  • Protagonismo, autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade de construir soluções em ambientes em desenvolvimento;
  • Facilidade para transitar entre negócio, jurídico, operação e tecnologia;
  • Orientação para resultado sem comprometer governança e segurança jurídica.


Principais Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Aumento da taxa e do valor de recuperação das carteiras;
  • Redução do tempo médio de tratamento e recuperação;
  • Aumento da conversão de acordos e promessas de pagamento;
  • Cumprimento dos SLAs operacionais;
  • Redução de falhas documentais e operacionais;
  • Qualidade e completude dos casos encaminhados à judicialização;
  • Evolução da produtividade e da capacidade operacional;
  • Maior previsibilidade sobre resultados, riscos e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Implantação de automações e ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência;
  • Satisfação dos clientes e stakeholders com a gestão das carteiras.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto (encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos/SP)
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ)
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto

title: Senior Sustainability Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Sustainability Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is Energizer Holdings, Inc.


Energizer Holdings responsibly creates products to make lives easier and more enjoyable. To do this, we lean into our culture as an organization – we win together, while serving each other, with a willingness to act boldly, all while doing right. Our colleagues hail from all backgrounds, nationalities and walks of life, but our shared mission and purpose make us one team. Because we’re a global organization, you will always have opportunities to learn, grow and develop in your career. We support flexible working arrangements wherever possible.


Position Summary


The Senior Sustainability Analyst plays a key role in advancing the company's sustainability strategy, reporting, compliance, and performance management programs. This position leads sustainability data collection, greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, reporting, assurance, and audit activities. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across global operations, the role ensures data integrity, transparency, and alignment with corporate sustainability goals and external reporting requirements. The role also provides project management support for sustainability initiatives, including coordinating meetings, tracking action items, developing presentations and communications, and supporting implementation of strategic priorities and programs.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing complex sustainability data and reporting processes across multiple global facilities.


Responsibilities


Specific Accountabilities


Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Accounting & Emissions Management:


  • Lead global Scope 1, Scope 2, and applicable Scope 3 GHG inventory development, data collection, emissions calculations, and reporting.
  • Maintain GHG methodologies, documentation, and data quality in alignment with the GHG Protocol and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to validate emissions data, support reduction initiatives, and ensure audit readiness.


Sustainability Reporting & Disclosure Management:


  • Lead project management and execution of the annual Sustainability Report, including timelines, stakeholder engagement, and approvals.
  • Coordinate content development, source documentation, communications, training materials, and website disclosures.


Assurance, Audit & Internal Controls:


  • Serve as the primary contact for sustainability audits and external assurance engagements.
  • Coordinate audit requests, maintain supporting evidence, and ensure effective reporting controls and governance.
  • Identify risks, implement corrective actions, and support successful completion of audits and assurance reviews.


Program Support:


  • Support implementation of evolving sustainability standards, frameworks, controls, and documentation processes.
  • Coordinate project meetings, stakeholder engagement, action-item tracking, and program documentation.


What we are looking for


Required Skills and Experience


  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, applying the Greenhouse Gas Protocol and related emissions reporting methodologies across multiple global facilities and operations.
  • Experience with external GHG emissions audits, assurance engagements, and verification processes.
  • Knowledge of sustainability reporting frameworks, regulations, and assurance requirements, including GRI, ISSB, CSRD, and related disclosure standards.
  • Proficiency with sustainability data management systems (e.g., Metrio) and advanced Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Strong project management, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting corporate sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and cross-functional initiatives across global operations.
  • Professional certifications in sustainability, environmental management, or GHG accounting are a plus.


Come join us!


Energizer is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture.
  • Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud.
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.
  • Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.
  • APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.
  • Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.
  • Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.
  • OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.
  • Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs).
  • Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs.
  • Experiência no setor Financeiro


Desejável:


  • Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture.
  • CQRS.
  • Event Sourcing.
  • Saga Pattern.
  • Outbox Pattern.
  • Consumer Driven Contracts.
  • GraphQL.
  • Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria.
  • Java, Go ou .NET.
  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102).
  • TOGAF.
  • Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas.
  • Conhecimento de Terraform


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED! The World's Most Driven Remote Operations Specialist


About Chore

Chore exists to kill admin so founders can \"Chore No More\" and build their dreams. We are the end of admin. We are the future. We are the better world for everyone.

We exist to make every startup in the world successful. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win.

We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning.

Check out more of what we do here:


🚀 The Role

We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists - the main conduit through which all of our clients' back-office operations run , including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance.

As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship - you own the operations. In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on.

These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless - and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first.


Some Examples Of The Work We Do

  • Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness - “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Work that gets genuinely strategic - e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases. An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer
  • Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind. Our clients are early-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget - not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to.
  • Contributing to our knowledge base. Internal, client-facing, and public-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice - and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice.
  • Internal projects that make Chore stronger. SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements - scoped, executed and delivered by you.


One note on scope: unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go-to-market, analytics or partnerships.


🧠 What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties. This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's.


Strongly preferred

  • HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience (We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background)


And you're probably a fit if…

  • You're a total geek for better processes - more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient.
  • Ticking items off your list while thinking \"how could I do this more efficiently?\" brings a smile to your face. There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done
  • You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter - you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries
  • You're smart, detail-oriented, a natural context-switcher, with GREAT communication skills
  • You have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by people - going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us
  • You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically
  • You're open to giving and receiving feedback , up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method
  • You start solving before you start asking. When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question
  • You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup - dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the \"startup plumber\" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2+ years). This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth - but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months

Nice to have, not required

  • An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early-stage startup finance
  • Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite


Why This Role Is Special

  • You will run real companies behind the scenes. Very few roles give you this much impact this early
  • You get ownership from day one. From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies - not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility
  • You get rare visibility. You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this
  • You work with sharp, ambitious teammates who care deeply about doing things well
  • You will grow faster than you imagined - start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs


Compensation & Logistics

  • Compensation. We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses of up to 30% based on performance.
  • India - $12K USD/year
  • Nigeria / Africa - $10.4K USD/year
  • LATAM - $13K USD/year

Note : we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

  • Equity. All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure.
  • Benefits (all eligible after you complete the 60-day probation period)
  • Up to $250/month WFH stipend
  • Up to $50/month wellness stipend
  • Location. We're remote-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours.
  • Schedule. US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit.


🦨 Read Before Applying

We believe in being upfront about the hard parts.

  • US hours are required and can be demanding. This may not be suitable for everyone
  • Remote work has real challenges. You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace
  • High ambiguity. You must create structure, not wait for it
  • Extreme context-switching. You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time
  • Feedback fluency. You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways
  • High ownership. Minimal hand-holding. You are expected to self-manage
  • Client-facing pressure. Founders move fast and expect clarity
  • 60-day fully paid probation period. We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates.


If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit.


❤️ Our Values

  • Delight All Stakeholders. Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself
  • Meritocracy. We reward value created - not longevity
  • Experiment & Adapt. Try things, learn fast, improve continuously
  • Assume Good Intentions. Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier


How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)


Please read this section carefully - following the instructions is part of how we assess applications.

Your application has two parts. Both are required.


Step 1 - Record a short video

Record one video, no longer than 3 minutes , answering these two questions:

1. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?

2. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own - not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved.

A few notes:

  • Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred)
  • We're not judging production quality - we want to hear how you think
  • We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please.


Step 2 - Submit the application form

(Only once your video is recorded)


Form:

When sharing your resume, please name as follows: Firstname.Lastname.OS - Resume - for example, Jane.Doe.OS - Resume. PDF preferred.


What Happens Next

We move quickly, and we'd rather you know exactly what's coming:

  • We review your application and video - usually within a week
  • A 30-minute screening call , so we can get to know you
  • A paid case study - 1 to 2 hours of work, with 72 hours to complete it. You'll receive a payment for your time
  • Four interviews , to meet different team members including a Chief Chore Officer (30 mins), a current Operations Specialist (30 mins), our head of Client Operations (30 mins) and finally our CEO (15 mins)
  • Offer rollout


We aim to go from application to decision in around three weeks.

title: IT Compliance & Controls Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para IT Compliance & Controls Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled IT Compliance & Controls Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type : Full-time

Location : Remote-Brazil

Industry : IT & Consulting


IT Compliance & Controls Analyst | About You

As an IT Compliance & Controls Analyst, you will help ensure the organization's technology, security, and quality processes comply with internal controls and industry standards. You will work closely with Engineering, Security, Risk, and Product teams to assess control effectiveness, support audit activities, monitor compliance risks, and drive remediation efforts. The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of IT controls, audit processes, and security governance with excellent analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.


IT Compliance & Controls Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Perform testing and validation of IT General Controls (ITGC), Information Security, and Quality Management System (QMS) controls to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
  • Assess the design and operational effectiveness of controls, identify control gaps, and support remediation efforts to strengthen compliance programs.
  • Support internal and external audits, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, through evidence collection, validation, audit coordination, and follow-up activities.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Security, Risk, and QMS teams to implement, enhance, and maintain effective governance, risk, and compliance processes.
  • Monitor compliance metrics, SLAs, risks, corrective actions, and key control indicators, providing regular reporting and visibility to stakeholders.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and develop dashboards, metrics, and executive reports to support compliance monitoring and leadership decision-making.


IT Compliance & Controls Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 2-4 years of experience in IT Compliance, IT Audit, IT General Controls (ITGC), Risk Management, Information Security Governance, Internal Controls, or Quality Management Systems (QMS).
  • Hands-on experience with ITGC and security controls, including Access Management, Identity Management, SDLC Controls, Change Management, Cybersecurity Controls, and Information Security Policies.
  • Experience supporting compliance and audit initiatives, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, internal audits, evidence collection, audit coordination, and remediation tracking.
  • Knowledge of risk and operational resilience practices, including Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, Encryption, Firewall Controls, and Logging & Monitoring.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, GRC platforms, evidence management tools, dashboards, and compliance reporting, with strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.


Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.

title: Relação com Investidores
description:

SOBRE A WHY CAPITAL :

A Why Capital é uma gestora de investimentos focada em ações listadas nos Estados Unidos, estruturada em uma estratégia de Fund of Funds. A gestora busca identificar e alocar capital nos melhores gestores dessa classe de ativos, realizando co-investimentos ao lado deles com uma visão de longo prazo.


Nossa filosofia de investimento é baseada na construção de um portfólio relativamente concentrado, composto por 20 a 30 empresas de alta qualidade, selecionadas por suas vantagens competitivas duradouras, elevado retorno sobre o capital investido (ROIC) e capacidade de capturar tendências estruturais de longo prazo, sustentando crescimento consistente ao longo dos anos. Com mentalidade de sócio e horizonte de investimento de longo prazo, a Why Capital prioriza paciência, baixa rotatividade do portfólio e decisões fundamentadas, evitando ruídos de curto prazo. Nosso objetivo é compor capital de forma consistente e sustentável ao longo dos anos, gerando retornos superiores para nossos investidores.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA :

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Relações com Investidores com perfil empreendedor para liderar o desenvolvimento de relacionamentos com profissionais de gestão de patrimônio e investidores institucionais em todo o Brasil. A principal missão será abrir novas oportunidades comerciais e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com:

  • Multi Family Offices
  • Single Family Offices
  • Bancos Privados (Private Banks)
  • Gestores de Patrimônio Independentes
  • Assessores de Investimentos
  • Consultorias de Investimento Institucional
  • Outros parceiros estratégicos de distribuição


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES :

  • Desenvolver e executar a estratégia de distribuição da Why Capital em todo o Brasil.
  • Identificar e estabelecer relacionamento com os principais tomadores de decisão de investidores institucionais.
  • Agendar e coordenar reuniões com potenciais investidores e parceiros de distribuição.
  • Representar a Why Capital em reuniões, conferências e eventos do mercado financeiro.
  • Manter o CRM e o funil de captação organizados e atualizados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o CIO na preparação de reuniões, materiais de acompanhamento e comunicações com investidores.
  • Coletar inteligência de mercado sobre preferências dos investidores.
  • Fortalecer a marca Why Capital e ampliar sua visibilidade junto à comunidade de Wealth Management no Brasil.
  • Apoiar todo o processo de captação de recursos, desde o primeiro contato até a entrada do investidor no fundo.


PERFIL DESEJADO :

  • Experiência em Relações com Investidores, Vendas Institucionais, Private Banking, Wealth Management ou Asset Management.
  • Relacionamento prévio com Family Offices, Private Bankers ou Assessores de Investimentos será considerado um diferencial importante.
  • Forte perfil comercial e excelente habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, com elevado senso de responsabilidade e autonomia.
  • Perfil organizado, disciplinado e proativo.
  • Português fluente e inglês em nível profissional.


DIFERENCIAL DA VAGA :

Esta não é uma posição em uma grande instituição com uma máquina de distribuição já estabelecida. É a oportunidade de ajudar a construir essa estrutura desde o início. Você trabalhará diretamente com o fundador da gestora, terá autonomia e desempenhará um papel central na definição da estratégia comercial da Why Capital. À medida que a empresa crescer, suas responsabilidades e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional crescerão na mesma proporção.


Buscamos alguém que queira construir algo relevante no longo prazo – e não apenas administrar uma carteira de relacionamentos já existente. O profissional selecionado terá a oportunidade de evoluir para uma posição de sócio da gestora ao longo do tempo, de acordo com seu desempenho e contribuição para o crescimento da empresa.


REMUNERAÇÃO :

  • Salário fixo.
  • Bônus anual de até 12 salários, condicionado ao desempenho.
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) vinculadas ao sucesso da captação de recursos, com período de vesting de 5 anos.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);

  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.

description:

  • Autonomia para propor, criar e testar novas soluções
  • Cultura colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:



O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Ficar com o cliente até o fim. Você atende uma carteira de clientes e conduz cada caso até a resolução. Se precisar de apoio técnico do time interno, você aciona o time e permanece responsável pelo cliente.


Entregar o Estudo Ada, o diagnóstico contábil da empresa do cliente. Você analisa o caso do cliente, aponta o que precisa ser feito e define as ações com prazos. O cliente sabe que você cuidou da empresa dele.


Atender por videochamada. Você terá seu calendário de reunião e entra na conversa preparado para ajudar o cliente. 


Na prática, isso significa:

  • Atender na linha de frente: WhatsApp, e-mail e chat da plataforma
  • Ler o histórico do cliente antes de responder 
  • Conduzir o chamado do início ao fim, dentro do SLA, e confirmar com o cliente que resolveu
  • Chamar reunião quando o caso pede conversa em vez de texto
  • Orientar o cliente na plataforma e mostrar o que ela resolve por ele
  • Avisar o time no primeiro sinal de que o cliente quer sair
  • Anotar as particularidades e os pontos de atenção de cada cliente, para o próximo atendimento já começar com contexto
  • Identificar problema que se repete e abrir ticket estruturado para engenharia


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • CRC ativo 
  • Experiência em fiscal, contábil, legalização ou abertura de empresas
  • Experiência em cuidar de uma carteira de clientes, e não só de uma fila de chamados
  • Comunicação clara, direta e empática, no texto e em reuniões 
  • Conforto com número, volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e satisfação do cliente fazem parte do seu dia
  • Autonomia para organizar o próprio trabalho no remoto
  • Calma para atender cliente irritado e ainda sair com o problema resolvido


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Repertório de ferramentas de atendimento: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Zendesk ou similares
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda  
  • Interesse real por tecnologia e produto. Você quer entender como funciona o que está atendendo


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Ficar com o cliente até o fim. Você atende uma carteira de clientes e conduz cada caso até a resolução. Se precisar de apoio técnico do time interno, você aciona o time e permanece responsável pelo cliente.


Entregar o Estudo Ada, o diagnóstico contábil da empresa do cliente. Você analisa o caso do cliente, aponta o que precisa ser feito e define as ações com prazos. O cliente sabe que você cuidou da empresa dele.


Atender por videochamada. Você terá seu calendário de reunião e entra na conversa preparado para ajudar o cliente. 


Na prática, isso significa:

  • Atender na linha de frente: WhatsApp, e-mail e chat da plataforma
  • Ler o histórico do cliente antes de responder 
  • Conduzir o chamado do início ao fim, dentro do SLA, e confirmar com o cliente que resolveu
  • Chamar reunião quando o caso pede conversa em vez de texto
  • Orientar o cliente na plataforma e mostrar o que ela resolve por ele
  • Avisar o time no primeiro sinal de que o cliente quer sair

O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • CRC ativo 
  • Experiência em fiscal, contábil, legalização ou abertura de empresas
  • Experiência em cuidar de uma carteira de clientes, e não só de uma fila de chamados
  • Comunicação clara, direta e empática, no texto e em reuniões 
  • Conforto com número, volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e satisfação do cliente fazem parte do seu dia
  • Autonomia para organizar o próprio trabalho no remoto
  • Calma para atender cliente irritado e ainda sair com o problema resolvido


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Repertório de ferramentas de atendimento: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Zendesk ou similares
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda  
  • Interesse real por tecnologia e produto. Você quer entender como funciona o que está atendendo


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

title: Cloud Architect

Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone)

This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone.


You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy.


Day to day, you will:

  • Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t.
  • Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start.
  • Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements.
  • Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies.
  • Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security.
  • Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale.
  • Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time.
  • Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them.
  • Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly.
  • Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
  • Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change.
  • Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards.
  • Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS.
  • Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions.
  • Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams.
  • Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles.


Required

  • Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent.
  • 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations.
  • 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services.
  • Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution.

  • Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design.

  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Writer (Brasil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.


Key Responsibilities


1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing

  • Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.
  • Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.
  • Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.
  • Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.
  • Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization

  • Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.
  • Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.
  • Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement

  • Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.
  • Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.
  • Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.
  • Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery

  • Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.
  • Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.
  • Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.
  • Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses

  • Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.
  • Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.
  • Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration

  • Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.
  • Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.
  • Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization

  • Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.
  • Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.
  • Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.
  • Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.
  • Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.
  • Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.
  • Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.
  • Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.


About SigmaMD


SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.


About this role


We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.


Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.


This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.


And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.


You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.


What you'll do


Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.


Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.


Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.


Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.


Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.


What we're looking for


1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.


2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.


3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.


4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.


Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.


Who you might be


You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.


Nice to have


  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.


Our values


Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.
