title: Product Manager - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Manager - Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis.

Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Orientação a Resultados e Negócio: Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Decisões Baseadas em Dados: Estabelecer uma cultura analítica forte, utilizando dados quantitativos e qualitativos para embasar o roadmap, priorizações e hipóteses.
  • Inovação e Eficiência com IA: Explorar e integrar o uso de Inteligência Artificial e automações para otimizar processos internos, melhorar a experiência do usuário e acelerar o time-to-market.
  • Alinhamento de Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de diversas áreas (comercial, operações, marketing, etc.) em produtos digitais funcionais, garantindo uma adoção real e sustentável pelas frentes de negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e desdobrar a visão, estratégia e o roadmap do produto, alinhando a tecnologia às necessidades de crescimento da companhia;
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery contínuos com usuários, clientes e áreas de negócio não-digitais, transformando dores reais em soluções de software;
  • Atuar com forte viés analítico, definindo, monitorando e comunicando KPIs claros de produto e impacto no negócio;
  • Avaliar cenários de Build vs. Buy (desenvolvimento interno vs. contratação de fornecedores), considerando custos, prazos e escalabilidade;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e parceiros de sistemas corporativos (como SAP e plataformas de mercado);
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto com metodologias ágeis, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e a melhoria contínua;
  • Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio , com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
  • Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);
  • Experiência sólida na gestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial) , LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto;
  • Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics);
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Histórico em projetos de transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados.


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;
  • Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto;
  • Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;
  • Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders.


Bora movimentar o esporte!!

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.


Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Information Technology Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior IT Business Analyst

Role Overview

The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.

The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.
  • Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.
  • Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.
  • Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.
  • Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.
  • Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.
  • Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.
  • Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.
  • Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.
  • Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications

Education and Experience


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.
  • Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.
  • General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.
  • Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.
  • Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.


Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.
  • Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.


Technical Expectations

The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.

Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

description:

Data Validation Engineer

Rate range: 20-28hr (PJ Contractor)


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years of experience in Data Validation, Data Quality, Big Data QA, ETL Testing, or a related field

• Strong Python development and writing code from scratch

• Advanced SQL skills with hands-on experience writing complex queries

• Experience validating large-scale datasets

• Experience testing ETL/ELT data pipelines

• Hands-on experience with BigQuery

• Experience performing source-to-target data reconciliation

• Experience troubleshooting data discrepancies and conducting root cause analysis

• Strong understanding of data quality principles, including:

o Data accuracy

o Data completeness

o Data consistency

o Data integrity

o Duplicate detection

• Experience working within GCP or AWS cloud data environments

• Experience with reporting tools

• Experience leveraging AI/LLM tools to improve data validation, analysis, or engineering workflows

• Experience creating or enhancing validation logic, reconciliation processes, or data quality checks using AI-assisted approaches


Job Description


Insight Global is seeking a Data Validation Engineer for an end client to join its QA Automation organization and serve as the team's subject matter expert for data quality and validation. This individual will be responsible for validating large-scale datasets, analytics platforms, and ETL pipelines that support streaming and digital products. The ideal candidate will have strong Python and SQL skills, experience working with BigQuery and cloud-based data environments, and a proven background validating data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. This role will also leverage AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to enhance data validation processes, automate analysis, improve anomaly detection, and accelerate root cause investigation. The Data Validation Engineer will partner closely with QA Automation Engineers, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure trusted data is available for reporting, analytics, and downstream testing efforts.

Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end data validation efforts across large-scale data pipelines and analytics platforms

• Validate data movement through ETL/ELT processes and identify discrepancies between source and target systems

• Develop and maintain Python-based data validation, reconciliation, and quality-checking scripts

• Write SQL queries to analyze data, investigate issues, and verify business logic

• Perform source-to-target validation across BigQuery and cloud-based data platforms

• Troubleshoot data quality issues and perform root cause analysis

• Leverage AI/LLM technologies (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to generate and optimize validation rules, SQL queries, reconciliation logic, and analysis summaries

• Utilize AI-assisted techniques for anomaly detection, trend analysis, and identification of data inconsistencies

• Partner with QA Automation Engineers to ensure reliable, trusted data is available for downstream testing efforts

• Support validation of analytics generated across web, mobile, and connected TV (CTV) platforms

• Collaborate within Agile teams using Jira and Confluence

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist


Who We Are:

Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.


Your Role:

As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform.


You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk

or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast.


Why this role matters:

Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it.


Responsibilities:

  • Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.


  • Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.


  • Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.


  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.


  • Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.


  • Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard


What We’re Looking For:

Must-haves:

  • Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one.
  • Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility.
  • Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone.
  • Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants.
  • Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection.
  • Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product.
  • Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows.
  • Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Strategic Partnerships/Sales Manager (Telecom Operators, Brazil)

Brazil is one of Latin America's largest telecom markets and a key strategic growth priority for Afina DMP. We are looking for an experienced Telecom partnerships and sales professional to take full ownership of this market and drive our regional expansion.


Success in this role means taking full ownership of the Brazilian market: engaging telecom operator stakeholders at all levels, navigating complex internal decision-making processes, and driving data monetization partnerships from first contact to scale.

- Drive Afina DMP integration across operator product, marketing, and commercial functions.

- Working schedule aligned with the Brazilian business calendar.

- Regular collaboration with international teams across multiple time zones.

title: Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco de talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Graphic Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.

  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

  • Participação em projetos de implementação, transformação ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.

  • Vivência em ambientes complexos, multiempresas e de grande porte.

  • Possuir visão funcional integrada dos módulos FI, MM e SD.
  • Ter experiência com estratégias de Clean Core e arquitetura orientada a boas práticas SAP.
  • Ser capaz de orquestrar especialistas técnicos e funcionais na construção de soluções de arquitetura.

Education and Experience Requirement


1. Bachelor or above education background, technical knowledge is a plus.

3. Successful track records of sales or procurement in feed industry.

Our Offer


We take our employees as the core assets of the company, and the company’s mission is to create values for the clients, and help the employees to achieve their personal dreams.


1. VEGA Group’s strong supply chain can provide the best products at the best price for you to compete with others, you can sell easily.

2. VEGA Group’s R&D Center and manufacturing bases can provide the cutting-edge technical support for you to satisfy clients’ various demand, your clients will be happy.

3. VEGA Group’s decades’ industrial experience will provide you tools and resources to help you develop in your country, you are not alone.

4. You will succeed and get rewarded once we are moving forward together.

5. Basic salary, commission, bonus, and equity incentive program.


Career Path


We will conduct a 360 degree evaluation based the candidate’s education, work experience, personal strengths and other related factors, and then discuss and decide the right designation for the right candidate.


The career path in our company is clearly designed as below: executive-> senior executive-> assistant manager-> manager-> senior manager-> associate director-> director-> line GM-> Country Manager-> Senior management and Partners.

VEGA has unparalleled strengths in the development, production and distribution of pharmaceutical products, food ingredients, animal health products, vitamins and premixes, disinfectants, packaging materials, medical equipment and tools.


VEGA has started global co-production expansion in local markets to serve local clients, furthermore, VEGA imports animal nutrition products from overseas to distribute in the Chinese market through our domestic networks.


With key competences in pharmaceuticals, food and animal health, VEGA has established extensive business networks in more than 100 countries. VEGA will continue to invest in R&D and global service networks to provide the best-in-class solutions and services to our clients.

Nice to Have

Responsabilidades:

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Member of the Board of Advisors em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.

Desirable

This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Product Designer (3-Month Contract)

Location: Remote


My client is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join their team on a 3-month contract, helping deliver high-impact improvements across key customer journeys and core product experiences.


This is a hands-on execution role suited to a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, can work independently with minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex UX challenges through thoughtful, polished design. You'll work closely with product and engineering teams to rapidly validate ideas, improve user experiences, and deliver production-ready designs that create measurable business impact.


You'll be involved in a variety of optimisation and product enhancement initiatives, including:

  • Improving cross-sell and upsell journeys to create seamless customer experiences.
  • Leading discovery and design work for subscription management features, from research through to high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conducting user interviews, usability testing, competitor analysis, and reviewing customer feedback to inform design decisions.
  • Enhancing landing pages and core product experiences to support international growth.
  • Improving authentication and account management user journeys.
  • Supporting additional product design initiatives as priorities evolve throughout the engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive, user-centred experiences across web and product platforms.
  • Rapidly design, prototype and iterate production-ready user interfaces that balance user needs with business outcomes.
  • Create high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Work within and extend an established design system, creating scalable, reusable components rather than one-off solutions.
  • Use analytics, funnel data, customer feedback, support insights and qualitative research to identify opportunities for optimisation.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to deliver features efficiently.
  • Take ownership of design challenges with minimal supervision, working from high-level objectives rather than detailed specifications.
  • Balance speed and quality while managing multiple priorities within a fixed delivery timeline.


Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years' commercial Product Design experience, ideally within SaaS or digital products.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, UX thinking and systems-based design.
  • Experience designing customer-facing B2C products and digital experiences.
  • Advanced Figma skills, including component libraries, prototyping and design systems.
  • Commercial experience working within and extending design systems using a component-first approach.
  • Commercial experience using AI-powered design and prototyping tools (Claude Design preferred).
  • Strong understanding of user research methodologies, usability testing and data-informed design.
  • Experience using analytics, funnel data, customer feedback and support insights to prioritise UX improvements.
  • Experience delivering high-quality design work within fast-paced product environments using lightweight processes.
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal direction and turning high-level objectives into production-ready designs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Desirable

  • Experience working within subscription-based or SaaS products.
  • Experience optimising conversion funnels and customer journeys.
  • Familiarity with internationalisation and localisation considerations.
  • Experience working within agile product teams.


What We're Looking For

  • A self-starter who can quickly understand problems and propose effective design solutions.
  • Someone who combines exceptional visual design with strong product thinking.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Passionate about creating intuitive, accessible and engaging user experiences.
  • Able to deliver high-quality work at pace without compromising design standards.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior AML Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AML Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.


Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.


Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key Responsibilities:

Utilize blockchain analysis tools and transaction monitoring systems such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, CipherTrace, etc., to analyze and monitor virtual currency transactions;

Conduct thorough reviews of transactional data to identify suspicious activities, patterns, and anomalies indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing;

Collaborate with internal teams to investigate flagged transactions, gather additional information, and make informed decisions on potential risks;

Stay updated on emerging trends, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices related to transaction monitoring in the virtual currency sector;

Document findings and maintain detailed records of transaction monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with audit and regulatory standards;

Communicate effectively, providing clear and concise reports and recommendations based on transaction monitoring outcomes;

Support continuous improvement initiatives related to transaction monitoring processes and systems.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, law, or a related field. Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE, CRCM) preferred;

At least 3 years of relevant work experience in AML, compliance, CDD, risk management, or the virtual currency industry;

Experience with virtual currency exchanges, payment platforms, or fintech companies is a plus;

Proficiency in using blockchain analysis tools and transaction monitoring systems such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, CipherTrace, etc;

Strong understanding of virtual currency transactions, blockchain technology, and associated risks;

Exposure of regional scope, including but not limited to APAC, Europe, Middle East etc. will be highly preferred.

Ability to identify and assess potential money laundering and terrorist financing risks in virtual currency transactions;

Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and draw actionable conclusions;

Excellent communication skills to convey findings and recommendations effectively.


Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

description:

Quem somos:

Studio Rx é uma empresa global de produção digital, criada para atender às necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como hub de produção da Omnicom, Studio Rx apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo qualidade e eficiência como pilares principais.


Seu Papel:

Como Designer Sênior, você será responsável pela execução de mudanças de design prescritas em projetos complexos com foco em táticas digitais. Você atuará como um profissional versátil, capaz de aplicar habilidades de design e colaborar efetivamente com Design de Experiência, Design de Produto, Copy, Desenvolvimento, Contas e Gerenciamento de Projetos com ritmo acelerado e foco orientado por prazos. Sua contribuição será fundamental para garantir qualidade e eficiência nas soluções digitais entregues. Seu trabalho será caracterizado por velocidade, eficiência e colaboração, com atenção aos detalhes e comunicação clara com times e parceiros. Você trabalhará dentro de limites e escopo definidos, sabendo quando escalar demandas e próximos passos.


Suas Responsabilidades:

  • Editar e atualizar projetos de design com profundidade técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Garantir que os designs permaneçam em conformidade com imperativos médicos, legais e regulatórios;
  • Garantir que os designs permaneçam em conformidade com as Diretrizes de Acessibilidade do Conteúdo Web;
  • Garantir que os designs permaneçam alinhados com diretrizes de marca e restrições do sistema de design;
  • Garantir que os designs possam ser construídos e desenvolvidos eficientemente nos sistemas alvo;
  • Executar atualizações, adaptações e otimizações de ativos para diferentes canais digitais;
  • Criar e adaptar designs para web, mobile, email, banners, redes sociais e outros formatos digitais em larga escala;
  • Redimensionar e adaptar ativos digitais de acordo com especificações para diferentes plataformas;
  • Trabalhar em projetos diversos: websites, IVAs, banners, emails e peças para eventos (painéis, peças de convenção);
  • Executar e manter layouts dentro de Design Systems estabelecidos, garantindo consistência e eficiência;
  • Funcionar no fluxo de design (routing & refinement), identificar necessidades de esclarecimento e sinalizar pontos críticos antes de prosseguir;

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.

description:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Associate Product Analyst who is passionate about AI, creator tools, and short-form video.   • Portfolio or social media profile showcasing your understanding of digital content is a plus.

title: Creative Strategist
description:

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Supply & Demand Planning Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supply & Demand Planning Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

Hydroh is a premium health and wellness company focused on developing innovative functional hydration, hydrogen water, electrolyte, and nutritional products that improve everyday performance and long-term health. We combine science-backed products, exceptional customer experiences, and operational excellence to build a modern consumer brand focused on long-term growth.

At Hydroh, we're advancing the future of hydration by making high-quality, research-backed products accessible to consumers worldwide. Our team thrives on innovation, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement, empowering people to perform at their best every day.


Role Description

Hydroh is seeking an experienced Supply & Demand Planning Manager to own and optimize our end-to-end planning processes. This full-time remote role is responsible for ensuring the right inventory is available at the right time while balancing customer service, inventory investment, and cash flow objectives.

The successful candidate will develop SKU-level demand forecasts, translate forecasts into purchasing and production plans, optimize inventory levels, and lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Logistics to align business priorities and support Hydroh's continued growth.


Qualifications
