What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth. 🚀

title: Power Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Transmission Line Engineer - LATAM


Our client is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer to join their growing engineering team. This role will be responsible for supporting the analysis, design, and execution of overhead transmission line projects for utility and energy clients.


The ideal candidate will have experience in transmission line design, power systems, and engineering project delivery, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the successful delivery of critical power infrastructure projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform and coordinate transmission line engineering activities for new and existing overhead transmission projects.
  • Complete engineering analysis, calculations, and design work associated with transmission line systems.
  • Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers, and project teams.
  • Review project requirements and specifications and recommend design improvements when necessary.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges related to transmission line design and construction.
  • Prepare technical reports, analyses, calculations, and presentations.
  • Perform and oversee transmission line calculations, including:
  • Sag-tension analysis
  • Wire blowout calculations
  • Swing angle analysis
  • Damper recommendations
  • Conductor and wire selection
  • Support multiple projects simultaneously while meeting project schedules and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and project management teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support project meetings, technical presentations, and project development activities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Experience working on utility, transmission, or power infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with transmission line design software such as:
  • PLS-CADD
  • SAG10
  • ETAP
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.


What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated and results-driven professional.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for professional growth and development.
  • Team player who thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Apply Today

If you are passionate about power systems, transmission engineering, and delivering innovative solutions for critical infrastructure projects, we would love to hear from you.

MCRA is part of IQVIA MedTech.

As a trusted CRO and advisory partner, IQVIA MedTech and MCRA deliver integrated lifecycle solutions for the medical device and diagnostics industry. Internally, that means operating in a complex, fast-moving environment where strong data, systems, and operational discipline are critical. title: Coordenador(a) de Monitoramento, Avaliação e Pesquisa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Monitoramento, Avaliação e Pesquisa em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Liderar a estruturação, análise e disseminação de dados educacionais que orientam a tomada de decisão de secretarias parceiras e da própria organização. A pessoa será responsável por transformar dados brutos de avaliações e indicadores educacionais em análises rigorosas e acionáveis, além de contribuir para o desenho de interfaces e integrações que facilitem o acesso e uso desses dados por gestores públicos e equipes internas.

Reportando à Gerência da área, a pessoa atuará na interseção entre pesquisa aplicada, gestão de dados e advocacy local baseado em evidências, com forte interlocução com equipes de programas, tecnologia e parceiros institucionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


Monitoramento e análise de dados

  • Coordenar a coleta, estruturação e análise de dados de avaliações educacionais (ex: SAEB, avaliações estaduais/municipais, indicadores de fluxo e aprendizagem).
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos analíticos e preditores de resultados educacionais, conectando dados de insumo, processo e resultado.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas pela organização e por parceiros.


Estruturação de ferramentas de dados

  • Contribuir para o desenho e a evolução de interfaces e painéis de visualização que tornem os dados acessíveis e compreensíveis para gestores de secretarias.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de tecnologia na definição de requisitos de integração entre diferentes fontes e sistemas de dados educacionais.
  • Traduzir necessidades de gestores públicos em especificações funcionais para novas funcionalidades analíticas.


Avaliação e pesquisa

  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações de processo e de resultado dos programas da organização.
  • Produzir estudos, notas técnicas e relatórios que subsidiem decisões estratégicas internas e de parceiros.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre literatura acadêmica e evidências em política educacional, aplicando-as ao contexto de atuação da organização.


Gestão de relacionamento e comunicação de dados

  • Apresentar análises e recomendações para lideranças de secretarias, conselho e financiadores, de forma clara e orientada à ação.
  • Apoiar a preparação de materiais para reuniões estratégicas, conselhos e eventos externos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de programa para garantir uso efetivo dos dados na gestão escolar e na formulação de políticas.


Gestão de equipe e processos

  • Coordenar analista(s) e/ou estagiário(s) da área de monitoramento e avaliação.
  • Estabelecer rotinas e protocolos de qualidade para produção e validação de análises.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Economia, Estatística, Ciências Sociais, Educação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados educacionais, avaliação de políticas públicas ou pesquisa aplicada.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (ex: Stata, R, Python ou SQL).
  • Experiência com bases de microdados educacionais (Censo Escolar, INEP, SAEB, avaliações estaduais) é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações claras para públicos não técnicos.
  • Vivência em desenho ou especificação de painéis/dashboards e interfaces de dados (não é necessário programar as ferramentas, mas sim saber especificar requisitos junto a times técnicos).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e oral, com experiência em produção de relatórios e apresentações.


Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação (mestrado ou doutorado) em Economia, Educação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia em organizações do terceiro setor, secretarias de educação ou instituições de pesquisa educacional.
  • Conhecimento de métodos de avaliação de impacto (ex: diferenças em diferenças, matching, regressão descontínua).
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de tecnologia educacional (EdTech) e ferramentas de IA aplicadas à educação.

This leader is responsible for a distributed support team providing first, second, and advanced technical support across the division’s software portfolio. The role defines the operating model, drives day-to-day service quality, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to deliver a unified, high-quality support experience to enterprise and mid-market customers alike.   • Define and execute the customer support strategy, operating model, and service frameworks aligned to ITIL best practices and division objectives.

  • Own end-to-end service delivery: including incident, problem, and change management
  • Establish, monitor, and report on the KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS measures that govern support performance
  • Provide oversight on complex technical escalations, root cause analysis, and cross-functional resolution across cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Own the support customer experience, including service reviews, senior escalations, key-account relationships, and the onboarding and adoption experience for new customers.
  • Build the knowledge management, self-service, and customer-facing documentation capabilities required to scale the function efficiently.
  • Lead adoption of automation, analytics, and AI-driven tooling; including FreshService and equivalent service management platforms
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing support organization
  • Provide regular reporting and insight to division leadership on support performance, customer risk, retention impact, and investment priorities.
  • Support the integration of newly acquired products into the support operating model as the portfolio evolves.


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in customer support or technical support, with at least 3 years leading distributed support teams within SaaS or software businesses.
  • Experience managing managers or team leads, and growing a support function over time.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL, support methodologies, and service management best practices, including incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong technical acumen across SaaS architectures, cloud environments (AWS and Microsoft Azure), web technologies, and relational databases
  • Track record managing the support relationship with Product and Engineering, including defect lifecycle, prioritisation, and roadmap influence.
  • Data-driven approach with hands-on experience using support KPIs, SLAs, and CSAT/NPS to drive measurable performance improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and key customers.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Must be bilingual English and Portuguese.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading support integration during mergers and acquisitions or multi-product portfolio consolidation.
  • Familiarity with FreshService or equivalent enterprise service management platforms.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted support, self-service deflection, and proactive monitoring capabilities at scale.
  • Background supporting customers in regulated industries (food, life sciences, manufacturing, or comparable).


This is a CLT role R$40-50K/month. Role is remote but some travel may be required. Both domestic and international.
